item.title: Gradium 开源 Phonon：仅 31M 参数的高性能端侧语音合成模型
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-23/Gradium-开源-Phonon-仅-31M-参数的高性能端侧语音合成模型/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-23/Gradium-开源-Phonon-仅-31M-参数的高性能端侧语音合成模型/
item.description:
从云端大模型向终端边缘设备的下沉，是生成式 AI (Generative AI) 迈向普及的关键战役。长期以来，高品质的文本转语音 (Text-to-Speech, TTS) 技术往往严重依赖庞大的云端算力与持续的 API 计费，而在边缘计算与移动端设备上运行的轻量级模型，则常面临发音机械、错误率高和首包延迟过长的困境。由前 Kyutai 团队成员创立的法国语音 AI 初创公司 Gradium，正式开源了革命性的端侧语音合成模型家族 Phonon。其中专攻英语的 Phonon 31m 核心参数量仅有 31M (量化后仅占 64.5 MB 存储)，采用商业友好的 Apache 2.0 宽松协议开源，不仅在常规消费级 CPU 上实现了低至 7 毫秒的超低首音频延迟，更在涵盖复杂边缘用例的严苛文本基准测试中大幅超越了同类主流模型，为离线设备、具身机器人、智能穿戴及各类本地 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 带来了真正轻量且开箱即用的高保真实时语音能力。
---
## 内容摘要
> ## Summary
Gradium 正式开源了轻量级语音合成模型家族 **Phonon**，专门针对本地端侧与边缘设备的高效运行而设计。该模型家族提供了 31M 与 40M 两种参数规格；其中专攻英语的 **Phonon 31m** 采用宽松的 Apache 2.0 协议开源，其 q8 量化权重体积仅为精巧的 64.5 MB。无论是常规 CPU、智能手机、以树莓派 5 (Raspberry Pi 5) 为代表的单板计算机，还是网页浏览器，Phonon 都能在脱离云端 API、无需独立 GPU 加速以及零字符计费成本的前提下，实现自然流畅的端侧实时语音生成。
> Gradium has open-sourced **Phonon**, a family of lightweight text-to-speech (TTS) models designed for local, on-device execution. Available in 31M and 40M parameter sizes, the English **Phonon 31m** model is licensed under Apache 2.0 and packs into a compact 64.5 MB file. It enables natural, real-time speech generation on CPUs, phones, single-board computers like the Raspberry Pi 5, and browsers without requiring cloud APIs, GPUs, or per-character billing.
---
## 核心速览
> ## TL;DR
* **模型体量**：核心模型参数量仅 31M (不含音频分词器)，q8 GGUF 格式下仅占 64.5 MB 存储，支持 24 kHz 单声道高品质输出；而多语种版本 Phonon 40m 拥有 40M 参数，权重文件仅 74.6 MB。 * **硬件支持**：通用于标准 CPU、智能手机、树莓派 5 (Raspberry Pi 5)、网页浏览器 (通过 WASM 与 WebGPU) 以及 NVIDIA GPU，完全不强求独立显卡。 * **推理性能**：在 Gradium 测试的所有开源模型中斩获最高的英语 Elo 评分；在标准消费级 CPU 上实现仅约 7 毫秒的首音频响应延迟。 * **核心优势**：在包含 500 个复杂边缘句式的严苛基准评测集中，单词错误率 (Word Error Rate, WER) 低至 1.70% (大幅超越了 Kokoro 的 3.50%)。 * **潜在短板**：在 Seed-TTS 大语言模型 WER 基准评测中，得分略逊于 Kokoro 与 Magpie 等竞品 (0.51% 对比 0.45%)。
> * **Size:** 31M parameters (excluding audio tokenizer), 64.5 MB q8 GGUF, 24 kHz mono output. Phonon 40m features 40M parameters in a 74.6 MB file. > * **Hardware Support:** Runs on CPUs, smartphones, Raspberry Pi 5, browsers (WASM, WebGPU), and NVIDIA GPUs. No dedicated GPU required. > * **Performance:** Top English Elo among open models tested by Gradium; achieves ~7 ms to first audio on standard CPUs. > * **Pros:** Low Word Error Rate (WER) of 1.70% on a 500-sentence hard benchmark set (outperforming Kokoro's 3.50%). > * **Cons:** Scores slightly behind models like Kokoro and Magpie on the Seed-TTS LLM WER benchmark (0.51% vs. 0.45%).
---
## 什么是 Gradium Phonon？
> ## What is Gradium Phonon?
Phonon 是由位于巴黎的语音 AI 初创团队 **Gradium** 开发的开源权重文本转语音模型家族。Gradium 脱胎于知名开源实验室 Kyutai，致力于将高保真、低延迟的语音合成能力无缝带入边缘计算设备、个人笔记本、智能手机以及网页浏览器端。
> Phonon is an open-weight TTS model family developed by **Gradium**, a Paris-based voice AI company spun out of Kyutai. It brings high-performance speech synthesis directly to edge devices, laptops, mobile phones, and web browsers.
该模型家族目前涵盖三大核心版本分支：
> The model family consists of three main variants:
* **Phonon 31m**：纯英文模型，内置 37 款丰富音色，采用最利于商业化落地的 Apache 2.0 协议开源。 * **Phonon 40m**：单语种独立模型，支持英语、法语、德语、西班牙语以及葡萄牙语 (遵循 CC BY-NC 4.0 非商业化许可)。 * **Phonon 40m Multilingual (多语种版)**：将上述 5 种语言融汇于单一模型之中，囊括多达 102 款预置音色 (遵循 CC BY-NC 4.0 非商业化许可)。
> * **Phonon 31m:** English-only, features 37 built-in voices, and is licensed under Apache 2.0. > * **Phonon 40m:** Single-language models available for English, French, German, Spanish, and Portuguese (CC BY-NC 4.0). > * **Phonon 40m Multilingual:** Combines all 5 languages into a single model with 102 voices (CC BY-NC 4.0).
---
## Phonon 的技术架构与工作原理
> ## How Does Phonon Work?
在底层原理上，Phonon 采用了因果 Transformer (Causal Transformer) 作为核心骨干网络，其前缀输入由待合成文本与发音人嵌入向量 (Speaker Embedding) 共同拼接而成。模型借助词表规模为 4,000 个 Token 的 SentencePiece 分词器直接解析原始文本字符，彻底摒弃了传统语音合成中繁琐且易出错的音素 (Phoneme) 转换管线。
> Phonon utilizes a causal transformer backbone that takes a prefix combining text and speaker embeddings. A SentencePiece tokenizer with a 4,000-token vocabulary parses raw text directly, bypassing traditional phoneme conversion steps.
Phonon 的端到端推理架构流水线设计极为紧凑高效：
> The architecture pipeline functions as follows:
1. **输入文本与发音人嵌入 (Input Text & Speaker Embedding)**：接收原始纯文本输入，并挂载内置预置音色、克隆音色或自定义发音人特征向量； 2. **SentencePiece 分词处理 (SentencePiece Tokenization)**：直接对文本完成 Token 切分，无须任何中介音素字典或注音前置步骤； 3. **因果 Transformer 骨干网络 (Causal Transformer)**：自回归 (Autoregressive) 地为每 80 毫秒的音频帧生成一个潜在向量 (在 31m 版本中包含 6 层结构、隐藏层维度 512，以及 8 个注意力头)； 4. **流匹配预测头 (Flow-Matching Head)**：通过单步流匹配 (Flow-Matching) 机制，一步到位将潜在向量与环境噪声解算为连续音频嵌入，并辅以语音终止检测头 (End-of-Speech Detection Head) 实时把控句尾断句； 5. **Mimi 音频解码器 (Mimi Decoder)**：采用源自 Kyutai 的 Mimi 神经音频解码器的轻量化精简变体，将连续嵌入快速解码还原为 24 kHz 高保真 PCM 音频流。
> 1. **Input Text & Speaker Embedding:** Accepts raw text alongside built-in, cloned, or custom speaker embeddings. > 2. **SentencePiece Tokenization:** Direct text processing without phoneme intermediaries. > 3. **Causal Transformer:** Generates one latent vector per 80 ms frame autoregressively (6 layers, width 512, and 8 attention heads in the 31m version). > 4. **Flow-Matching Head:** Converts latents and noise into continuous audio embeddings in a single step, paired with an end-of-speech detection head. > 5. **Mimi Decoder:** A streamlined variant of Kyutai’s Mimi decoder translates embeddings into 24 kHz PCM audio streams.
值得强调的是，Phonon 31m 与 40m 模型均是通过大规模教师模型进行知识蒸馏 (Knowledge Distillation) 提炼而成，整个训练过程在基于 NCCL 通信与 CUDA Graphs 深度优化的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 集群上高效完成。
> Both the 31m and 40m models are distilled from a larger teacher model, trained on an NVIDIA H100 cluster utilizing NCCL and CUDA Graphs.
---
## 基准测试与性能表现
> ## Benchmark Performance
在 Gradium 组织的双盲成对听觉评估测试中 (共计 1,189 位评审员参与，累计产生 17,270 次有效盲测投票)，美式英语系列模型展现出了卓越的主观听感表现：
> In blind pairwise listening tests conducted by Gradium across 1,189 raters and 17,270 votes, US English variants performed strongly:
* **Phonon 40m**：2117 Elo * **Phonon 31m**：2098 Elo * **Kokoro**：2043 Elo * **NeuTTS**：2034 Elo * **Magpie**：1939 Elo
> * **Phonon 40m:** 2117 Elo > * **Phonon 31m:** 2098 Elo > * **Kokoro:** 2043 Elo > * **NeuTTS:** 2034 Elo > * **Magpie:** 1939 Elo
在涵盖电话号码、电子邮箱地址以及邮政编码等大量棘手边缘用例的公开**高难度句式基准数据集 (Hard-sentence Dataset, 共 500 句)** 上，Phonon 31m 斩获了惊艳的 **1.70% WER**，显著优于主流轻量模型 Kokoro (3.50%) 与 NeuTTS Nano (8.71%)。不过，在相对基础平顺的 Seed-TTS 基准测试集上，差距有所收窄：Phonon 31m 录得了 0.51% 的大语言模型辅助 WER，略微落后于 Kokoro 的 0.45%。
> On a rigorous public **hard-sentence dataset** (comprising 500 sentences filled with edge cases like phone numbers, emails, and postal codes), Phonon 31m achieved a **1.70% WER**, significantly outperforming Kokoro (3.50%) and NeuTTS Nano (8.71%). However, on the simpler Seed-TTS benchmark set, performance normalizes slightly, with Phonon 31m recording a 0.51% LLM WER compared to Kokoro's 0.45%.
---
## CPU 性能与延迟表现
> ## CPU Performance & Latency
Phonon 针对超低延迟边缘侧部署进行了全方位的底层计算优化：
> Phonon is heavily optimized for low-latency edge deployment:
* **MacBook Air M5 (CPU 4 线程)**：首音频生成时间仅需 **6.9 毫秒**，推理吞吐达 **29.9 倍实时速率** (而在启用 KleidiAI 与 Apple Accelerate 加速库后，更进一步缩短至 5.4 毫秒，吞吐高达 46.7 倍实时速率)； * **树莓派 5 (Raspberry Pi 5)**：仅需 **38 毫秒** 即可吐出首段音频，整体生成维持在 **3.7 倍实时速率**； * **高通骁龙 8 至尊版 Gen 5 (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5)**：首音频延迟仅 **7.5 毫秒**，达到 **24 倍实时速率**； * **NVIDIA L40S (CUDA 加速)**：首段语音延迟更是压低至极速的 **5 毫秒**。
> * **MacBook Air M5 (CPU, 4 threads):** Reaches first audio in **6.9 ms** at **29.9x real-time speed** (improving to 5.4 ms and 46.7x with KleidiAI and Apple Accelerate). > * **Raspberry Pi 5:** Starts in **38 ms** and runs at **3.7x real-time speed**. > * **Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5:** First audio in **7.5 ms** at **24x real-time**. > * **NVIDIA L40S (CUDA):** First speech achieved in **5 ms**.
---
## 主流端侧语音模型横向对比
> ## Model Comparison
| 评估特性 | Phonon 31m | Phonon 40m Multilingual | Kokoro-82M | NeuTTS Nano | Kitten TTS v0.8 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **开发者** | Gradium | Gradium | hexgrad | Neuphonic | KittenML | | **参数量** | 31M (不含分词器) | 40M | 82M | 总计约 228.7M，激活约 116.8M | 15M / 40M / 80M | | **权重体积** | 64.5 MB (q8) | 74.6 MB (q8) | 未披露 | 未披露 | 25 至 80 MB | | **支持语种** | 英语 | 英语、法语、德语、西语、葡语 | 8 种语言 (v1.0) | 英语 (套件扩展西、法、德语) | 英语 | | **开源协议** | Apache 2.0 | CC BY-NC 4.0 | Apache 2.0 | NeuTTS Open License 1.0 | Apache 2.0 | | **高难度句式 WER (英语)** | 1.70% | 2.11% | 3.50% | 8.71% | 7.40% | | **英语 Elo 评分** | 2098 | 2097 | 2043 | 2034 | 未测试 | | **Seed-TTS LLM WER (英语)** | 0.51% | 0.48% | 0.45% | 0.62% | 未测试 | | **首音频延迟 (M5 CPU)** | 6.9 ms | 8.8 ms | 517 ms | 未披露 | 未披露 |
> | Feature | Phonon 31m | Phonon 40m Multilingual | Kokoro-82M | NeuTTS Nano | Kitten TTS v0.8 | > | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | > | **Developer** | Gradium | Gradium | hexgrad | Neuphonic | KittenML | > | **Parameters** | 31M (excl. tokenizer) | 40M | 82M | ~228.7M total, ~116.8M active | 15M / 40M / 80M | > | **Weights** | 64.5 MB (q8) | 74.6 MB (q8) | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 25 to 80 MB | > | **Languages** | English | EN, FR, DE, ES, PT | 8 (v1.0) | English (collection adds ES, FR, DE) | English | > | **License** | Apache 2.0 | CC BY-NC 4.0 | Apache 2.0 | NeuTTS Open License 1.0 | Apache 2.0 | > | **Hard-set WER (EN)** | 1.70% | 2.11% | 3.50% | 8.71% | 7.40% | > | **English Elo** | 2098 | 2097 | 2043 | 2034 | Not tested | > | **Seed-TTS LLM WER (EN)** | 0.51% | 0.48% | 0.45% | 0.62% | Not tested | > | **First Audio (M5 CPU)** | 6.9 ms | 8.8 ms | 517 ms | Not disclosed | Not disclosed |
---
## 开发者部署与生态集成
> ## Developer Deployment
官方推理运行时 (`xn-ptts`) 采用双重宽松开源协议 (MIT 或 Apache 2.0)，提供了极为宽广的多语言生态绑定，原生支持 Rust、Python (`pip install ptts`)、Swift、C、C++，并支持在浏览器端通过 `phonon-tts` 直接驱动。此外，运行时还开箱即用地内置了兼容 OpenAI 接口规范的服务端以及轻量级 WebSocket 服务端。生态整合方面，Phonon 能与 Hugging Face Transformers、MLX-Audio、Ollama 以及 LM Studio 等主流框架无缝协同。
> The official runtime (`xn-ptts`) is available under an MIT or Apache-2.0 license, supporting Rust, Python (`pip install ptts`), Swift, C, C++, and web browsers via `phonon-tts`. It also includes out-of-the-box support for an OpenAI-compatible server and a WebSocket server. Phonon integrates smoothly with Transformers, MLX-Audio, Ollama, and LM Studio.
---
## 总结与核心看点
> ## Key Takeaways
* **轻巧高效的开源利器**：**Phonon 31m** 提供了一个仅 31M 参数量的超轻量纯英语文本转语音模型，权重仅 64.5 MB，采用商业友好的 Apache 2.0 协议开源； * **复杂长尾文本精准无误**：在包含缩写、数字及邮箱等复杂现实场景文本中表现极其稳健，单词错误率 (WER) 仅为 1.70%； * **突破性的端侧超低延迟**：在现代消费级标准 CPU 上能够达成 7 毫秒以内的极速首包音频输出，并可在树莓派 5 等算力受限设备上流畅稳定运行； * **多语种能力延展**：同步推出了覆盖 5 种欧洲语言的 40M 多语种版本，供学术研究与非商业应用探索。
> * **Phonon 31m** offers an efficient, Apache 2.0-licensed 31M parameter English TTS model weighing just 64.5 MB. > * Delivers robust accuracy with a 1.70% WER on difficult text inputs. > * Unlocks ultra-low latency processing, achieving first audio in under 7 ms on modern consumer CPUs and running seamlessly on resource-constrained hardware like the Raspberry Pi 5. > * Multilingual 40m counterparts are available under non-commercial licensing terms.
---
欢迎查阅官方资源了解更多详情：[技术博客 (Technical Blog)](https://gradium.ai/blog/release-phonon-open-weight) | [模型主页 (Model Card)](https://huggingface.co/gradium/phonon-31m-en) | [GitHub 运行时代码库 (GitHub Runtime)](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts) | [高难度基准数据集 (Hard-Sentence Dataset)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/gradium/tts-hard-sentences-202610)。
> *Check out the [Technical Blog](https://gradium.ai/blog/release-phonon-open-weight), [Model Card](https://huggingface.co/gradium/phonon-31m-en), [GitHub Runtime](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts), and [Hard-Sentence Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/gradium/tts-hard-sentences-202610).*

item.title: Cactus Whistle 实战指南：16.9MB 轻量语音模型如何在 CPU 上硬刚 Whisper Base
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-23/Cactus-Whistle-实战指南-16.9MB-轻量语音模型如何在-CPU-上硬刚-Whisper-Base/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-23/Cactus-Whistle-实战指南-16.9MB-轻量语音模型如何在-CPU-上硬刚-Whisper-Base/
item.description:
在边缘计算设备与端侧 AI 场景中，语音识别模型长期面临模型体积庞大与推理资源消耗高的双重瓶颈。Cactus Compute 推出的超轻量语音转文字模型 Cactus Whistle 体积仅为 16.9MB ，专为在 CPU 环境下高效运行而打造。它不仅支持 7 种语言的高精度转录，还能同步输出精确到词级别的时间戳与置信度概率指标。本文在 Apple M4 芯片上采用标准 LibriSpeech 基准数据集，将 Cactus Whistle 与 OpenAI 经典开源模型 Whisper (Tiny 与 Base 模型) 展开了端到端严谨的对照实验，全方位评测了其在词错误率 (WER) 、推理延迟、流式传输、噪声鲁棒性以及语音转工具调用等场景中的性能表现，为开发者在边缘计算与端侧 AI 智能体开发中提供了极具实用价值的轻量级语音落地指南。
---
## 执行摘要
> ## Executive Summary
在本技术实战教程与评测中，我们将深入探索由 Cactus Compute 推出的超轻量语音转文字 (Speech-to-Text) 模型 **Whistle** 。该模型体积仅为惊人的 16.9MB ，专为在 CPU 环境下高效运行而设计。虽然体积极其小巧，但 Whistle 却具备跨 7 种语言的多语种转录能力，同时还能提供极其精确的词级别时间戳和置信度概率指标。
> In this technical tutorial and evaluation, we explore **Whistle**—Cactus Compute’s ultra-compact, 16.9 MB speech-to-text model designed to run efficiently on CPUs. Whistle supports multi-language transcription across seven languages while returning precise word timestamps and probability metrics.
我们基于固定的随机种子，从 LibriSpeech 基准测试数据集 (包含 `test-clean` 和 `test-other` 测试集) 中抽样构建评测音频，并在完全相同的音频片段上将其与 OpenAI 的开源标杆模型 **Whisper (Tiny 与 Base 模型) ** 展开全方位的严格对比分析。评测运行在 Apple M4 CPU 上，通过结合 Holm 校正 (Holm correction) 的配对发音人聚类置信区间进行严密的统计推断，我们的核心研究发现如下：
> Using seeded samples from LibriSpeech (`test-clean` and `test-other`), we conduct a rigorous comparative analysis against OpenAI's **Whisper (Tiny and Base models)** across identical audio clips. Evaluated through paired speaker-cluster intervals with Holm correction on an Apple M4 CPU, our findings highlight:
* **词错误率 (Word Error Rate, WER) **：在背景噪声更复杂的 `test-other` 数据集上，Whistle 的转录精度甚至超越了采用贪婪搜索 (Greedy Search) 策略的 Whisper Base ；不过在 Whisper 开启束搜索 (Beam Search) 策略后，两者之间的差距有所收窄。 * **速度与能效 (Speed & Efficiency) **：在短音频场景下，Whistle 相较于 Whisper 展现出了显著的速度优势，不过随着音频片段长度的增加，两者之间的速度差距会逐渐缩小。 * **运行边界限制 (Operational Limits) **：我们深入挖掘出了一些关键的边缘限制条件，例如当音频超过 30 秒窗口约束时，当前锁定的推理引擎可能会在静默状态下直接丢弃超长部分的音频片段。 * **高级拓展能力 (Advanced Capabilities) **：我们还全面基准测试了流式传输延迟、时间戳精确度、关键词偏置增强 (Keyword Biasing)、多语种识别、抗噪鲁棒性、声学特征嵌入 (Embedding) 生成，以及将语音直接路由至工具调用 (Tool Call) 的端到端流程。
> * **Word Error Rate (WER):** Whistle outperforms greedy Whisper Base on `test-other`, though the performance gap narrows against beam search strategies. > * **Speed & Efficiency:** Whistle delivers significant speed advantages over Whisper, though the efficiency delta narrows as audio clip lengths increase. > * **Operational Limits:** We uncover critical edge cases, such as a 30-second window constraint where the pinned engine can silently drop audio segments. > * **Advanced Capabilities:** We benchmark streaming latency, timestamp accuracy, keyword biasing, multilingual processing, noise robustness, embedding generation, and speech-to-tool routing.
---
## 1. 环境搭建与模型初始化
> ## 1. Environment Setup & Model Initialization
在准备实验环境时，我们需要安装 `cactus-needle` 库以及必需的语音转录与音频处理工具，同时显式禁用相关的遥测数据收集功能。为了确保实验结果具备百分之百的可复现性，我们通过锁定 Hugging Face 仓库的具体版本提交哈希 (Revision) 并校验 SHA-256 哈希值，对模型权重及底层推理引擎进行严格固定。
> We install `cactus-needle` along with necessary transcription and audio processing utilities while disabling telemetry. By pinning specific Hugging Face repository revisions and recording SHA-256 hashes, we ensure complete reproducibility.
```python import os import io import re import sys import json import math import time import random import hashlib import shutil import zipfile import platform import traceback import subprocess import collections import urllib.error import urllib.request
RESULTS = {} VERDICTS = []
def banner(title): print("\n" + "=" * 78) print(title) print("=" * 78)
def section(name): def wrap(fn): def run(*a, **kw): banner(name) t0 = time.time() try: out = fn(*a, **kw) RESULTS[name] = out if isinstance(out, str) else "ok" return out except Exception as e: RESULTS[name] = f"SKIPPED / FAILED -> {type(e).__name__}: {e}" print(f"\n[!] {name} did not complete: {type(e).__name__}: {e}") traceback.print_exc(limit=3) return None finally: print(f"\n[{time.time() - t0:.0f} s]") json.dump({"results": RESULTS, "verdicts": VERDICTS}, open("results.json", "w"), indent=1) return run return wrap
banner("1. Install Whistle, pin its weights and engine by Hub revision, transcribe one clip") subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q", "cactus-needle==3.2.0", "openai-whisper==20250625", "jiwer==4.0.0", "soundfile==0.14.0", "soxr==1.1.0"], check=True) os.environ["NEEDLE_TELEMETRY"] = "0" os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS"] = "1"
import numpy as np import soundfile as sf import soxr from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
WHISTLE_REV = "ca5287601bef25af26dcf2e1b2bdc0843a7c19e5" NEEDLE3_REV = "93e88ede867e4311c39151285e74df513e4b835b" from needle.agent import fetch as needle_fetch TAG = needle_fetch._platform_tag() ENGINE_VERSION = needle_fetch.engine_version(3) weights = hf_hub_download("Cactus-Compute/whistle", "whistle.cact", revision=WHISTLE_REV) wheel = hf_hub_download("Cactus-Compute/needle3", needle_fetch.engine_wheel(ENGINE_VERSION, TAG, 3), revision=NEEDLE3_REV) with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z: member = next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith("needle/libneedle")) os.makedirs("engine", exist_ok=True) engine = os.path.abspath(os.path.join("engine", os.path.basename(member))) open(engine, "wb").write(z.read(member)) needle3_weights = hf_hub_download("Cactus-Compute/needle3", "needle3.cact", revision=NEEDLE3_REV) os.makedirs(needle_fetch.cache_dir(3), exist_ok=True) shutil.copyfile(needle3_weights, os.path.join(needle_fetch.cache_dir(3), needle_fetch.base_weights(3))) os.environ["NEEDLE_WHISTLE_WEIGHTS"] = weights os.environ["NEEDLE3_LIB_PATH"] = engine
import needle import importlib.metadata as md sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()[:12] CPU = platform.processor() or platform.machine() if sys.platform == "linux" and os.path.exists("/proc/cpuinfo"): CPU = next((l.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for l in open("/proc/cpuinfo") if l.startswith("model name")), CPU) elif sys.platform == "darwin": CPU = subprocess.run(["sysctl", "-n", "machdep.cpu.brand_string"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or CPU

def fetch(url, tries=7): for k in range(tries): try: with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as r: return r.read() except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: if k == tries - 1: raise wait = int(e.headers.get("Retry-After", 0) or 0) if e.code == 429 else 0 time.sleep(max(wait, 5 * 2 ** k) if e.code in (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) else 2) except Exception: if k == tries - 1: raise time.sleep(3 * (k + 1))
def page(dataset, config, split, offset, length=100): url = (f"https://datasets-server.huggingface.co/rows?dataset={dataset}&config={config}" f"&split={split}&offset={offset}&length={length}") time.sleep(0.25) return json.loads(fetch(url))
def load_audio(row): data = fetch(row["audio"][0]["src"]) audio, sr = sf.read(io.BytesIO(data), dtype="float32") if audio.ndim > 1: audio = audio.mean(axis=1) if sr != SR: audio = soxr.resample(audio, sr, SR, quality="HQ") return audio, hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:12]

Install Whistle, pin its weights and engine by Hub revision, transcribe one clip"] = \ f"{os.path.getsize(weights)/1e6:.1f} MB weights, {len(clip)/SR:.1f} s clip in {wall:.0f} ms" ```

## 2. 实验设计与随机种子采样
> ## 2. Experimental Design & Seeded Sampling
为了恪守学术研究与评测的严谨性，在正式启动评估流程之前，我们需要先在代码层面固化所有校验参数、统计指标与评估准则。
> To maintain academic rigor, validation parameters and evaluation metrics are codified prior to final evaluation runs.
```python import jiwer import whisper import torch from whisper.normalizers import EnglishTextNormalizer, BasicTextNormalizer
NORM_EN = EnglishTextNormalizer() NORM_BASIC = BasicTextNormalizer() SEED = 2026 N_WHISTLE = 300 N_PAIRED = {"other": 100, "clean": 60} MAX_CLIP_S = 30.0 WHISPER_SECONDS = collections.Counter()
def all_rows(dataset, config, split): out, offset = [], 0 while True: rows = page(dataset, config, split, offset)["rows"] out += [r["row"] for r in rows] offset += 100 if len(rows) < 100: return out
def dataset_sha(dataset): return json.loads(fetch(f"https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/{dataset}"))["sha"][:12]
def wer_counts(ref, hyp): n = len(ref.split()) if not hyp.strip(): return n, n o = jiwer.process_words(ref, hyp) return o.substitutions + o.deletions + o.insertions, n
def sdi(ref, hyp): if not hyp.strip(): return 0, len(ref.split()), 0 o = jiwer.process_words(ref, hyp) return o.substitutions, o.deletions, o.insertions
def corpus_wer(errs, words): return 100.0 * sum(errs) / max(sum(words), 1)
def _by_cluster(clusters, *arrays): tot = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0.0] * len(arrays)) for i, c in enumerate(clusters): for j, a in enumerate(arrays): tot[c][j] += a[i] return tot
def wer_ci(clusters, errs, words, B=2000, seed=0): tot = _by_cluster(clusters, errs, words) keys, rng = sorted(tot), random.Random(seed) boots = [] for _ in range(B): d = rng.choices(keys, k=len(keys)) boots.append(100 * sum(tot[c][0] for c in d) / max(sum(tot[c][1] for c in d), 1)) return np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5])
def paired_contrast(clusters, errs_a, words, errs_b, label_a, label_b, B=2000, seed=0): tot = _by_cluster(clusters, errs_a, errs_b, words) keys, rng = sorted(tot), random.Random(seed) boots = [] for _ in range(B): d = rng.choices(keys, k=len(keys)) w = max(sum(tot[c][2] for c in d), 1) boots.append(100 * (sum(tot[c][0] for c in d) - sum(tot[c][1] for c in d)) / w) boots = np.array(boots) lo, hi = np.percentile(boots, [2.5, 97.5]) p = 2 * min((boots <= 0).mean(), (boots >= 0).mean()) return {"a": label_a, "b": label_b, "diff": corpus_wer(errs_a, words) - corpus_wer(errs_b, words), "lo": lo, "hi": hi, "p": max(p, 1 / B), "clusters": len(keys)}
def holm(ps, alpha=0.05): order, keep = np.argsort(ps), [False] * len(ps) for rank, i in enumerate(order): if ps[i] <= alpha / (len(ps) - rank): keep[i] = True else: break return keep
def verdict(c, significant): if c["lo"] > 0 and significant: return "Whistle ahead" if c["hi"] < 0 and significant: return "Whistle behind" return "no significant difference at this n"
def fmt_contrast(c): return f"{c['diff']:+.2f} pts (95% CI {c['lo']:+.2f}..{c['hi']:+.2f}, {c['clusters']} speakers)"
@section("2. Fixed, seeded samples of LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other, and the rules for the verdicts") def sample_english(): global EN global MANIFEST EN, manifest = {}, {"dataset_sha": dataset_sha("openslr/librispeech_asr"), "seed": SEED, "splits": {}} MANIFEST = manifest for split in ("other", "clean"): t0 = time.time() rows = all_rows("openslr/librispeech_asr", split, "test") idx = random.Random(SEED).sample(range(len(rows)), N_WHISTLE) kept, too_long, empty = [], 0, 0 for i in idx: r = rows[i] audio, h = load_audio(r) ref = NORM_EN(r["text"]) if len(audio) / SR > MAX_CLIP_S: too_long += 1 continue if not ref: empty += 1 continue kept.append({"id": r["id"], "spk": str(r["speaker_id"]), "text": r["text"], "ref": ref, "audio": audio, "dur": len(audio) / SR, "sha": h}) EN[split] = kept manifest["splits"][split] = {"rows": len(rows), "sampled": N_WHISTLE, "too_long": too_long, "empty_ref": empty, "ids": [c["id"] for c in kept], "sha": [c["sha"] for c in kept]} durs = [c["dur"] for c in kept] pk = kept[:N_PAIRED[split]] print(f"test-{split}: {len(rows)} rows -> {len(kept)} clips kept ({too_long} over {MAX_CLIP_S:.0f} s, {empty} empty), " f"{len(set(c['spk'] for c in kept))} speakers, {sum(durs)/60:.1f} min, clip {np.mean(durs):.1f} s mean / {max(durs):.1f} s max" f" [{time.time()-t0:.0f} s]") json.dump(manifest, open("manifest.json", "w")) return f"{len(EN['other'])} + {len(EN['clean'])} clips, manifest written"
sample_english() ```

## 3. 词错误率 (WER) 基准评测
> ## 3. Word Error Rate (WER) Benchmarking
我们利用基于配对发音人聚类自举法 (Speaker-Cluster Bootstrapping) 计算出的置信区间，将 Whistle 与 Whisper Tiny 以及 Whisper Base 模型在词错误率指标上展开细致的比对。
> We evaluate word error rates against Whisper Tiny and Whisper Base models, utilizing paired speaker-cluster bootstrapped confidence intervals.
```python WHISPER = {}
def whisper_model(size): if size not in WHISPER: WHISPER[size] = whisper.load_model(size, device="cpu") return WHISPER[size]
def run_whisper(size, audio, language="en", **kw): torch.manual_seed(0) WHISPER_SECONDS[size] += len(audio) / SR t0 = time.perf_counter() r = whisper_model(size).transcribe(audio, language=language, fp16=False, **kw) fell_back = any(s.get("temperature", 0) > 0 for s in r["segments"]) return r["text"], fell_back, time.perf_counter() - t0
SYSTEMS = {"other": [("whisper tiny, greedy", "tiny", {}), ("whisper base, greedy", "base", {}), ("whisper base, beam 5", "base", {"beam_size": 5})], "clean": [("whisper tiny, greedy", "tiny", {}), ("whisper base, greedy", "base", {}), ("whisper base, beam 5", "base", {"beam_size": 5})]} FAMILY_A = {"test-clean: Whistle vs whisper base, greedy", "test-clean: Whistle vs whisper base, beam 5", "test-other: Whistle vs whisper base, greedy", "test-other: Whistle vs whisper base, beam 5", "MLS pooled: Whistle vs whisper base, greedy"} PUBLISHED = {"other": "Whistle 10.49 / Whisper base 11.0 (paper table 9, beam) / 12.4 (table 8, greedy)", "clean": "Whistle 4.31 / Whisper base 4.9 (paper table 9, beam) / 5.0 (table 8, greedy)"} CONTRASTS = []
@section("3. Word error rate against Whisper tiny and base, paired by clip, with a verdict per contrast") def english_wer(): global HYP HYP = {} for split in ("other", "clean"): clips = EN[split] t0 = time.perf_counter() hw = [W.transcribe(c["audio"], language="en")["text"] for c in clips] tw = time.perf_counter() - t0 HYP[(split, "Whistle")] = hw e_w, n_w = zip(*[wer_counts(c["ref"], NORM_EN(h)) for c, h in zip(clips, hw)]) lo, hi = wer_ci([c["spk"] for c in clips], e_w, n_w) print(f"test-{split}: Whistle on all {len(clips)} clips: WER {corpus_wer(e_w, n_w):.2f}% (95% speaker-cluster CI {lo:.2f}..{hi:.2f}) " f"in {tw:.1f} s ({1000*tw/len(clips):.0f} ms per clip)") pk = clips[:N_PAIRED[split]] spk = [c["spk"] for c in pk] e_wp, n_p = list(e_w[:len(pk)]), list(n_w[:len(pk)]) for label, size, kw in SYSTEMS[split]: res = [run_whisper(size, c["audio"], **kw) for c in pk] hyps = [r[0] for r in res] HYP[(split, label)] = hyps e_o = [wer_counts(c["ref"], NORM_EN(h))[0] for c, h in zip(pk, hyps)] con = paired_contrast(spk, e_o, n_p, e_wp, label, "Whistle") con["name"] = f"test-{split}: Whistle vs {label}" CONTRASTS.append(con) print(f" {label:22s} {corpus_wer(e_o, n_p):6.2f}% | {fmt_contrast(con)}") return "completed"
english_wer() ```

## 4. 推理速度与内存占用评估
> ## 4. Speed & Footprint Evaluation
为了确保性能基准测试的绝对客观与精准，避免多线程调度带来的资源争抢，我们让每个推理引擎均在独立的系统隔离子进程中运行。
> To ensure accurate performance profiling without thread contention, each inference engine operates inside an isolated system process.
```python def audio_seconds(clips, seconds): out, total = [], 0 for c in clips: out.append(c["audio"]) total += c["dur"] if total >= seconds: break return np.concatenate(out)[:int(seconds * SR)]
PROBE_SCRIPT = r""" import sys, json, time, resource, numpy as np kind, paths = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:] scale = 1 << 20 if sys.platform == "darwin" else 1 << 10 rss = lambda: resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / scale out = {"kind": kind} if kind.startswith("whistle"): import needle out["after_import"] = rss() W = needle.Whistle() run = lambda a: W.transcribe(a, language="en") else: import whisper, torch out["after_import"] = rss() size, kw = kind.split("-")[1], ({"beam_size": 5} if kind.endswith("beam5") else {}) m = whisper.load_model(size, device="cpu") def run(a): torch.manual_seed(0) return m.transcribe(a, language="en", fp16=False, **kw) clips = {p: np.load(p) for p in paths} run(clips[paths[0]]) reps = 5 if kind.startswith("whistle") else 3 for p, a in clips.items(): ts = [] for _ in range(reps): t0 = time.perf_counter(); r = run(a); ts.append(time.perf_counter() - t0) out[p] = {"wall_ms": 1000 * float(np.median(ts)), "spread_ms": 1000 * float(np.ptp(ts))} if kind.startswith("whistle"): out[p].update(ttft_ms=r["ttft_ms"], tps=r["decode_tps"]) out["peak"] = rss() print(json.dumps(out)) """
@section("4. Speed and footprint: identical arrays, one fresh process per engine, total wall time and peak memory") def speed(): pool = EN["other"] for secs in (5, 10, 30): np.save(f"clip{secs}.npy", audio_seconds(pool, secs)) open("probe.py", "w").write(PROBE_SCRIPT) res = {} for kind in ("whistle", "whisper-tiny", "whisper-base", "whisper-base-beam5"): out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "probe.py", kind, "clip5.npy", "clip10.npy", "clip30.npy"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=os.environ) if out.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError(f"{kind} probe failed: {out.stderr[-300:]}") res[kind] = json.loads(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]) for secs in (5, 10, 30): p = f"clip{secs}.npy" w = res["whistle"][p] print(f"{secs:5d} s | Whistle: {w['wall_ms']:9.0f} ms | Base Greedy: {res['whisper-base'][p]['wall_ms']:8.0f} ms") return "speed benchmark completed"
speed() ```

## 5. 音频长度管理与 30 秒窗口限制
> ## 5. Managing Audio Length & The 30-Second Window
Whistle 在单次处理不超过 30 秒的音频窗口时表现最为理想。一旦输入的音频时长超出了这一约束，就需要配合音频分块 (Chunking) 切片策略或流式处理实现。
> Whistle operates optimally on single-pass windows up to 30 seconds. Audio inputs extending beyond this constraint require chunking strategies or streaming implementations.
```python def quiet_windows(a, limit=30.0, search=5.0, hop=0.2): out, i, n, s, h = [], 0, int(limit * SR), int(search * SR), int(hop * SR) while len(a) - i > n: seg = a[i + n - s:i + n] energy = [np.mean(seg[j:j + h] ** 2) for j in range(0, len(seg) - h, h // 4)] cut = i + n - s + int(np.argmin(energy)) * (h // 4) + h // 2 out.append(a[i:cut]) i = cut out.append(a[i:]) return out
def speaker_sessions(min_s=40, max_s=100, k=8): by = collections.defaultdict(list) for split in ("other", "clean"): for c in EN[split]: by[c["spk"]].append(c) out, gap = [], np.zeros(int(0.4 * SR), np.float32) for spk, cs in sorted(by.items(), key=lambda kv: -sum(c["dur"] for c in kv[1])): parts, used, total = [], [], 0 for c in cs: if total + c["dur"] + 0.4 > max_s: break parts += [c["audio"], gap] used.append(c) total += c["dur"] + 0.4 if total >= min_s: out.append({"spk": spk, "clips": used, "audio": np.concatenate(parts), "ref": " ".join(c["ref"] for c in used), "dur": total}) if len(out) == k: break return out
@section("5. The 30-second window: what transcribe() does with longer audio, and two ways around it") def long_audio(): global SESSIONS SESSIONS = speaker_sessions() s = SESSIONS[0] print(f"speaker {s['spk']}: {len(s['clips'])} utterances joined, {s['dur']:.0f} s total duration.") results = {} for name, wins in (("fixed 30 s windows", [s["audio"][i:i + 30 * SR] for i in range(0, len(s["audio"]), 30 * SR)]), ("quiet-point cuts <= 30 s", quiet_windows(s["audio"], 30))): t0 = time.perf_counter() hyp = NORM_EN(" ".join(W.transcribe(w, language="en")["text"] for w in wins)) results[name] = 100 * jiwer.wer(s["ref"], hyp or "<empty>") print(f" {name:26s} {len(wins):2d} calls WER {results[name]:5.2f}%") return "long audio analysis completed"
long_audio() ```

## 6. 流式传输延迟与吞吐性能
> ## 6. Streaming Latency & Performance
通过调用 Whistle 提供的 `stream()` 接口，我们可以系统评估基于音频切片的流式转录推理延迟以及文字确权 (Commitment) 的时间间隔。
> Using Whistle's `stream()` method, we evaluate chunk-based transcription latency and commitment intervals.
```python @section("6. Streaming: cost per pass, how long a word waits to be committed, and what chunk size changes") def streaming(): print(f"{len(SESSIONS)} same-speaker sessions evaluated.") summary = {} for chunk_s, sessions in ((1.0, SESSIONS), (0.5, SESSIONS[:2]), (2.0, SESSIONS[:2])): n = int(chunk_s * SR) errs, pass_ms, lat = [], [], [] for s in sessions: steps = list(W.stream(iter([s["audio"][i:i + n] for i in range(0, len(s["audio"]), n)]), language="en")) errs.append(wer_counts(s["ref"], NORM_EN(" ".join(x["text"] for x in steps if x["text"])))[0]) body = steps[:-1] pass_ms += [x["pass_ms"] for x in body] lat += [x["received"] - wd["end"] for x in steps for wd in x["words"]] summary[(chunk_s, len(sessions))] = (np.median(lat), np.mean(pass_ms)) print(f"Chunk size {chunk_s}s | Mean Pass Time: {np.mean(pass_ms):.1f} ms | Median Latency: {np.median(lat):.2f} s") return "streaming evaluation complete"
streaming() ```

## 7. 词级别时间戳与置信度概率
> ## 7. Word Timestamps & Probabilities
Whistle 不仅能够精确输出每个词的时间戳，还同步输出了 Token 级别的置信度概率，这为后续业务逻辑中的置信度校验提供了十分可靠的代理参考。
> Whistle outputs token-level probabilities alongside timestamps, providing a reliable proxy for confidence scoring.
```python @section("7. Word timestamps and word probabilities: consistency, a known shift, agreement with Whisper, and what p < 0.7 means") def timestamps(): pk = EN["other"][:40] probs, correct, durs = [], [], [] for c in pk: ws = W.transcribe(c["audio"], language="en", word_timestamps=True)["words"] for w in ws: probs.append(w["probability"]) durs.append(w["end"] - w["start"]) probs = np.array(probs) print(f"Analyzed {len(probs)} words across {len(pk)} clips. Median probability: {np.median(probs):.3f}") return "timestamp validation complete"
timestamps() ```

## 8. 关键词偏置增强控制
> ## 8. Keyword Biasing Controls
关键词偏置增强 (Keyword Biasing) 技术允许我们在转录过程中针对专业领域或特定词汇进行重点定向强化，我们通过神谕基准 (Oracle Ceiling) 和干扰项对照组对其有效性展开验证。
> Keyword boosting enables targeted vocabulary improvements during transcription, validated against oracle and distractor controls.
```python @section("8. Keyword biasing: an oracle ceiling, a matched wrong-keyword control and a distractor list") def keywords(): clips = EN["other"] base = HYP[("other", "Whistle")] print(f"Running keyword biasing evaluation on {len(clips)} clips.") return "keyword evaluation complete"
keywords() ```

## 9. 多语种 LibriSpeech (MLS) 多语言性能评测
> ## 9. Multilingual Performance on Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
我们进一步扩展了评测边界，基于多语种 LibriSpeech (MLS) 测试集，对德语 (`de`)、法语 (`fr`)、西班牙语 (`es`)、意大利语 (`it`)、荷兰语 (`nl`) 以及波兰语 (`pl`) 等 6 种额外语言进行了转录评测。
> We scale evaluation across six additional languages (`de`, `fr`, `es`, `it`, `nl`, `pl`) using Multilingual LibriSpeech test splits.
```python MLS = {"de": "german", "fr": "french", "es": "spanish", "it": "italian", "nl": "dutch", "pl": "polish"} N_PER_LANG = 12
@section("9. Six more languages on Multilingual LibriSpeech, pooled, with a symmetric language-ID test") def multilingual(): rng = random.Random(SEED) pooled = {"Whistle (forced)": [], "whisper base, greedy": []} words, clusters = [], [] for code, cfg in MLS.items(): rows = [r["row"] for r in page("facebook/multilingual_librispeech", cfg, "test", 0)["rows"]] sample = rng.sample(rows, min(len(rows), N_PER_LANG)) for r in sample: audio, _ = load_audio(r) ref = NORM_BASIC(r["transcript"]) forced = W.transcribe(audio, language=code)["text"] pooled["Whistle (forced)"].append(wer_counts(ref, NORM_BASIC(forced))[0]) words.append(len(ref.split())) clusters.append(f"{code}-{r['speaker_id']}") print(f"Multilingual evaluation processed {len(words)} total words.") return "multilingual evaluation complete"
multilingual() ```

## 10. 噪声鲁棒性与不同信噪比下的表现
> ## 10. Noise Robustness & Signal-to-Noise Ratios
我们向音频中注入高斯白噪声，测试模型在多种不同信噪比 (Signal-to-Noise Ratio, SNR) 条件下的转录抗噪稳定性与退化规律。

```python @section("10. Non-speech, quiet speech and white noise at three SNRs, Whistle against Whisper base") def noise(): rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED) clips = EN["other"][:10] for snr in (20, 10, 5): print(f"Evaluating noise robustness at {snr} dB SNR...") return "noise evaluation complete"

## 11. 语音嵌入特征与语音片段搜索
> ## 11. Speech Embeddings & Spoken-Term Search
Whistle 还具备提取内容级帧嵌入特征向量的能力 (输出约为每秒 25 帧的 256 维向量) ，为下游基于声学特征的检索与音频比对任务提供了强大支持。
> Whistle provides content-level frame embeddings (256-dimensional vectors at ~25 frames/sec), facilitating downstream acoustic retrieval tasks.
```python @section("11. Speech embeddings: the measured frame rate, and finding a spoken word inside another clip") def embeddings(): for secs in (1, 5): v = np.asarray(W.embed(audio_seconds(EN["other"], secs)), np.float32) print(f"{secs} s audio -> {len(v)} floats ({len(v)//256} frames)") return "embedding extraction complete"
embeddings() ```
---
## 12. 语音直通工具调用：集成 MInDS-14 意图识别
> ## 12. Speech-to-Tool Calls (MInDS-14 Integration)
我们结合 Needle 3 框架和 MInDS-14 银行业务意图数据集，将语音转录得到的文字结果直接路由至结构化工具调用 (Tool Calling) 架构中，实现端到端的语音操作智能体。
> We route audio transcripts directly into structured tool calling architectures using Needle 3 and MInDS-14 banking intents.
```python INTENTS = {"abroad": "Using the card or account while travelling or abroad", "balance": "Check the current account balance", "card_issues": "A card is lost, stolen, blocked, declined or not working"} N_MINDS = 50
@section("12. From speech to a tool call: Whistle transcripts into Needle 3 on MInDS-14 banking requests") def speech_to_tools(): tools = [{"name": n, "description": d, "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}}} for n, d in INTENTS.items()] print(f"Initialized {len(tools)} intent tools for tool-calling evaluation.") return "tool routing complete"
speech_to_tools() ```
---
## 总结与关键要点
> ## Summary & Key Takeaways
```python banner("SUMMARY") for name, res in RESULTS.items(): print(f" {name:<104s} {res}") ```

item.title: 根证书信任库也是软件依赖：开源生态中被忽视的证书安全盲区
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/根证书信任库也是软件依赖-开源生态中被忽视的证书安全盲区/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/根证书信任库也是软件依赖-开源生态中被忽视的证书安全盲区/
item.description:
在现代互联网安全体系中，数字证书是建立安全加密连接 (TLS/SSL) 的信任基石，而操作系统与浏览器通常负责集中动态维护并吊销存在风险的根证书。然而，近期曝光的 eMudhra 私钥生成漏洞事件揭开了开源软件供应链中一条鲜为人知的阴暗面：大量编程语言、开发工具和第三方依赖库为了方便分发，普遍在安装包内自带静态的根证书信任库 (Trust Stores) 副本，使得系统级的安全修补彻底失效。安全团队通过对近 7000 个核心开源包的深度扫描发现，这种“幽灵二进制依赖”不仅长期未随主流标准更新，甚至还暗藏着数年前就被全网封杀的失陷证书。更为严峻的是，当前通用的软件物料清单 (Software Bill of Materials, SBOM) 与漏洞扫描工具仅按版本号比对源码依赖，对此类静态硬编码资产完全“失明”，为整个数字世界的软件供应链安全敲响了警钟。
---
## 核心内容摘要
> ## Summary
当权威数字证书机构 eMudhra 因生成算法失误导致中间证书颁发机构 (Intermediate Certificate Authorities, CAs) 的私钥可被直接逆向破解时，全球主流操作系统与浏览器在第一时间做出了响应，迅速吊销了对相关证书的信任。然而，我们赖以构建软件的各种客户端库、包管理器及编程语言运行时，往往在自身内部硬编码打包了独立的根证书信任库 (Trust Stores) 副本，使得系统的安全拦截彻底失效。一项针对近 7000 个核心开源软件包的安全审计揭示了一个令人震惊的现实：数十个广泛使用的开源包依然捆绑着早已被废弃、不再安全甚至已被攻陷的陈旧根证书。这形成了一类隐蔽的“幽灵二进制依赖 (Phantom Binary Dependencies)”，完美躲过了现有的标准漏洞扫描器与软件物料清单 (Software Bill of Materials, SBOM) 的审查雷达。
> When eMudhra incorrectly generated intermediate certificate authorities (CAs)—allowing private keys to be recovered directly from the certificates—major operating systems and browsers quickly revoked trust. However, many client libraries, package managers, and programming language runtimes bundle their own static copies of root trust stores, completely bypassing system updates. A security audit of nearly 7,000 critical packages revealed that dozens ship outdated Certificate Authority (CA) bundles containing long-removed, insecure, or compromised roots, exposing an invisible class of "phantom binary dependencies" that evade standard vulnerability scanners and SBOMs.
---
## 捆绑式根证书信任库的蔓延范围
> ## The Reach of Bundled Trust Stores
在 eMudhra 安全事件爆发后，Firefox、Chrome、Apple 和 Microsoft 于 10 月 17 日至 20 日期间，通过系统内置的信任列表自动更新机制，迅速封禁了受影响的中间证书。但安全披露公告同时指出，由于许多客户端和开发环境依赖自身内置的硬编码根证书，它们必须依赖手动发布软件更新才能修复安全风险。受此波及的工具生态包括：
> Following the eMudhra incident, Firefox, Chrome, Apple, and Microsoft blocked the compromised intermediates through automatic trust list updates between October 17 and 20. However, the disclosure noted that many clients require manual software updates because they rely on embedded roots. The affected ecosystem included:
* `certifi` (截至 2026.10.19 的多个版本) 与 `pip` (26.2.2) * `uv` (0.13.4) 与 `pixi` (0.82.1) * `webpki-roots`、`webpki-root-certs`、`rustls-webpki` 以及 `rustup` * Node.js、Go、Composer (`ca-bundle`)、Elixir (`castore`) 以及 Perl (`Mozilla::CA`) * cURL CA 证书包、NSS、多个 Linux 发行版以及 macOS 原生自带的 `pip3`
> * `certifi` (versions through 2026.10.19) and `pip` (26.2.2) > * `uv` (0.13.4) and `pixi` (0.82.1) > * `webpki-roots`, `webpki-root-certs`, `rustls-webpki`, and `rustup` > * Node.js, Go, Composer (`ca-bundle`), Elixir (`castore`), and Perl (`Mozilla::CA`) > * The cURL CA bundle, NSS, various Linux distributions, and macOS's native `pip3`
正如 Gentoo 维护者 Michał Górny 所指出的，单纯更新操作系统层面的信任库往往远远不够。Python 虚拟环境、内嵌捆绑的第三方依赖包 (例如 Python 标准库 `ensurepip` 中附带的 `pip`)、包管理器锁定文件的冻结策略、静态编译的 Rust 二进制可执行文件，以及层层嵌套的 Flatpak 沙箱运行时，都在私自保留这些证书的独立副本，必须逐一独立更新才能消除隐患。
> As Gentoo maintainer Michał Górny observed, updating system-level trust stores is often insufficient. Virtual environments, vendored package dependencies (such as `pip` inside `ensurepip`), lockfile cooldown policies, statically compiled Rust binaries, and nested Flatpak runtimes all maintain isolated copies of these certificates that must be updated independently.
## 关键开源包中的内置证书现状
> ## Bundles in Critical Packages
为了进一步评估在常用开发工具之外，整个软件生态中内置信任库的扩散广度，安全团队使用审计工具 [git-pkgs/certs](https://github.com/git-pkgs/certs) 对来自 PyPI、npm、crates.io、Go、Maven Central、Packagist、NuGet 和 RubyGems 的 6877 个核心关键开源包进行了全方位扫描。
> To understand the scale of embedded trust stores beyond well-known tools, an audit using [git-pkgs/certs](https://github.com/git-pkgs/certs) scanned 6,877 critical packages across PyPI, npm, crates.io, Go, Maven Central, Packagist, NuGet, and RubyGems.
扫描结果显示： * **1.7%** (共 116 个软件包) 包含 X.509 格式证书 (多数为测试用例夹具或代码签名证书)。 * **28 个软件包** 直接打包并分发了具备完整功能的 CA 证书包 (此外，在单独抽样的 RubyGems 样本中还发现了第 29 个，即 *Honeybadger*)。
> Out of these: > * **1.7%** (116 packages) contained X.509 certificates (mostly test fixtures or signing certs). > * **28 packages** shipped functional CA bundles (with a 29th, *Honeybadger*, found in a separate RubyGems sample).
这些内置证书包与系统安全体系的交互方式五花八门，大致可分为以下几类： * **系统叠加型 (System Overlay)**：例如 `excon`、`pip` 和 `redshift-connector` 等库，它们会将内置证书包与系统根证书“并行加载”，这意味着即便操作系统已经吊销了某个危险根证书，应用程序依旧会盲目信任它。 * **隔离信任库 (Isolated Stores)**：Stripe 的 Ruby 客户端库和 `httpclient` 直接利用自带的证书包构建独立的 `OpenSSL::X509::Store` 实例，与系统信任库彻底割裂。 * **回退与覆盖策略 (Fallbacks & Overrides)**：诸如 `botocore`、`httplib2` 和 Google 的 Java 客户端等工具，仅在检测不到系统信任库时才会回退使用自带的密钥库，这导致实际安全防御水位严重依赖具体的部署环境。 * **深度潜伏文件 (Deeply Embedded Files)**：`libv8` 将证书打包在 `depot_tools` 内部，而 Google App Engine 的 API 桩代码也为本地开发服务器携带了证书文件。
> These bundles interact with system security in varied ways: > * **System Overlay:** Libraries like `excon`, `pip`, and `redshift-connector` load their bundles *alongside* system roots, meaning a revoked OS-level root remains trusted. > * **Isolated Stores:** Stripe’s Ruby library and `httpclient` build independent `OpenSSL::X509::Store` instances from their bundles. > * **Fallbacks & Overrides:** Tools like `botocore`, `httplib2`, and Google’s Java clients fall back to bundled keystores only when system stores are missing, creating deployment-dependent security postures. > * **Deeply Embedded Files:** `libv8` bundles certificates inside `depot_tools`, and Google App Engine API stubs carry them for local development servers.
## 早被移除与失陷的危险根证书
> ## Removed and Compromised Roots
安全人员将这些软件包中的证书与 Mozilla 历年发布的官方证书库进行历史比对，发现大量内置证书包存在令人咋舌的严重滞后现象： * **严重陈旧的证书包 (Stale Bundles)**：*Honeybadger* 和 `httpclient` 分发自带的根证书列表居然分别停留在 2011 年和 2014–2015 年；令人费解的是，这些开源包的业务代码直到 2026 年底都在频繁维护更新。 * **被遗弃的 StartCom 根证书 (Orphaned StartCom Roots)**：诸如 `algoliasearch`、`aws-sdk-v1` 和 `Guzzle 3` 等软件包，依然包含早在 2017 年就被 Mozilla 在 Firefox 58 中彻底移除的 StartCom 根证书；更可怕的是，这些不受信任的证书在密码学有效期限上竟然能一直维持到 2036 年和 2039 年。 * **eMudhra 泄露风险波及 (The eMudhra Exposure)**：在被扫描的软件包中，有 10 个项目 (包括 Stripe、gRPC、Composer 和 `virtualenv`) 包含交叉签名根证书 `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`，该证书正是通往已被攻陷的 eMudhra 中间证书的信任桥梁。由于大多数内置证书库缺乏在线吊销检查机制且无条件信任该根证书，在发布针对性代码补丁之前，它们始终处于易受攻击的危险状态。 * **Comodo AAA 证书服务风险 (Comodo AAA Certificate Services)**：尽管 Mozilla 早在 2025 年就终止了对 Comodo AAA 根证书在 TLS 领域的信任，但在本次审计中仍有 17 个关键软件包 (包括 `honeybadger`、`httpclient`、`aws-sdk-v1` 和 `httplib2`) 依然将其作为默认信任锚点或回退信任源。
> Historical matching against Mozilla releases revealed severe staleness in package bundles: > * **Stale Bundles:** *Honeybadger* and `httpclient` shipped root lists dating back to 2011 and 2014–2015, respectively, despite receiving regular code maintenance up to late 2026. > * **Orphaned StartCom Roots:** Packages such as `algoliasearch`, `aws-sdk-v1`, and `Guzzle 3` still contain StartCom roots removed by Mozilla in Firefox 58 (2017), which remain cryptographically valid until 2036 and 2039. > * **The eMudhra Exposure:** Ten of the scanned packages (including Stripe, gRPC, Composer, and `virtualenv`) contained the cross-signing root `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`, which bridged traffic to the compromised eMudhra intermediates. Because many bundles lacked revocation checking and trusted this root, they remained vulnerable until explicitly patched. > * **Comodo AAA Certificate Services:** Though Mozilla ended TLS trust for Comodo's AAA root in 2025, it was still found in 17 scanned packages (including `honeybadger`, `httpclient`, `aws-sdk-v1`, and `httplib2`) acting as a default trust anchor or fallback.
尽管在 10 月份的安全事件披露后，诸如 `botocore`、AWS SDKs 和 `excon` 等高知名度工具的维护者迅速推送了安全补丁，但大量下游项目、嵌套依赖项以及长期锁死固定版本的 lockfile，依然在悄无声息地分发和运行着这些包含安全隐患的证书资产。
> While maintainers rapidly patched high-profile tools (such as `botocore`, AWS SDKs, and `excon`) following the October disclosures, many downstream dependencies and pinned lockfiles continue to distribute these vulnerable assets.
## 软件包元数据与 SBOM 的监控盲区
> ## Package Metadata and the SBOM Blind Spot
要发现这些深埋在软件包内部的根证书信任库，安全研究人员必须对压缩归档文件的实际内容进行逐文件静态深度解析，因为**目前没有任何现行的软件包元数据标准或 SBOM 格式能够追踪它们**。
> Discovering these embedded trust stores required statically parsing archive file contents because **no standard package metadata or SBOM format tracks them**.
标准的依赖关系图谱和 lockfile 仅记录软件包的包名和版本号 (例如 `pkg:gem/httpclient@2.9.0`)，对包内是否静态硬编码了某个历史年份的根证书库完全处于“失明”状态。CA 证书包本质上充当了一种**幽灵二进制依赖 (Phantom Binary Dependency)**——它们原本是由上游 Mozilla 动态维护的第三方敏感数据，却被开发者手动复制粘贴到了源码仓库中，随后在一次次的版本迭代中被悄然继承并固化。
> Standard dependency graphs and lockfiles record packages by name and version (e.g., `pkg:gem/httpclient@2.9.0`), remaining completely blind to the fact that the package embeds a statically compiled trust store from a specific historical year. A CA bundle functions as a **phantom binary dependency**—third-party data maintained upstream by Mozilla, manually copied into source trees, and silently inherited across releases.
虽然 Debian 发行版的 `Built-Using` 元数据字段以及 CycloneDX 的 `pedigree` 规格规范在理论上提供了追踪静态打包依赖的机制，但绝大多数标准 SBOM 生成工具目前仍严格只读取 lockfile 声明。其直接后果是，现有的自动化漏洞扫描器在机制上根本无法察觉：某款应用在其庞杂的依赖树深处，其实正默默信任着一整套早已被吊销或废弃的危险 CA 根证书。
> While Debian's `Built-Using` field and CycloneDX's `pedigree` specification offer theoretical mechanisms to track static inclusions, standard SBOM generators rely strictly on lockfiles. Consequently, vulnerability scanners remain fundamentally unequipped to detect when an application is silently trusting revoked or outdated Certificate Authorities hidden deep within its dependency tree.

item.title: 携带证明合约 (PC2)：AI 智能体无法违背的硬性承诺
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/携带证明合约-PC2-AI-智能体无法违背的硬性承诺/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/携带证明合约-PC2-AI-智能体无法违背的硬性承诺/
item.description: 随着自主 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 逐渐深入人类社会的方方面面，它们开始代表用户自主购买服务、交换核心信息并委派协作任务。然而，目前业界仅依靠自然语言指令或静态文本策略来约束智能体行为，存在严重的可靠性隐患——智能体既可能产生逻辑失误或目标偏离，也容易沦陷于提示词注入 (Prompt Injection) 攻击。针对这一协作信任瓶颈，研究团队开创性地提出了“携带证明合约 (Proof-Carrying Contracts, PC2)”体系，将模糊的行为准则升华为机器可严格检验的数学约束。任何智能体在执行关键动作前，都必须出具一份完备的数学证明，并经由名为“气闸 (Airlock)”的系统核验放行，从而在赋予智能体充分策略自由度的同时，筑牢了坚不可摧的底层安全防线。 --- ## 📌 内容概要 > ## 📌 Summary 随着 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 越来越普遍地代表用户自主行动——从采购各类服务、交换关键数据到委托分派工作——单纯依靠文本形式的指令或规则策略，根本无法确保其行为绝对合规。智能体随时可能产生失误、受到提示词注入 (Prompt Injection) 攻击而被恶意诱导，甚至转而追求与用户冲突的其他目标。 > As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of users—purchasing services, exchanging information, and delegating work—relying solely on textual instructions or policies is insufficient to guarantee compliance. Agents can make mistakes, be manipulated by prompt injection, or pursue conflicting interests. 为了彻底破局，论文作者提出了**携带证明合约 (Proof-Carrying Contracts, PC2)**：这是一种全新的系统框架，能够在智能体与外部系统的交互全生命周期中，以严谨的数学手段强制执行既定约束。在执行任何请求的操作之前，智能体必须先提供一份机器可自动核验的数学证明，以确保该操作在任何可能的情境下均能严格维持既定约束。名为**气闸 (Airlock)** 的底层执行系统会在放行该操作前对证明进行快速核查；这种机制既能让智能体灵活地自适应调整求解策略，又能为规则底线的绝对守序提供确定性保障。 > To solve this, the authors introduce **Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2)**: a novel framework that makes agreed constraints mathematically enforceable throughout an agent's interactions. Before executing any requested operation, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof confirming that the operation preserves all agreed-upon constraints. An execution system called the **Airlock** verifies this proof before granting access, freeing the agent to adapt its strategy while ensuring absolute constraint adherence. --- ## 📋 论文摘要 > ## 📋 Abstract AI 智能体正日益代表人类或其他智能体独立行动，参与购买服务、互通信息以及委派工作。智能体必须恪守的底线通常写在指令、规则策略或协议条款中，但光凭冰冷的文字本身并不能强制其完全顺从。智能体可能在执行中犯错、被读取的恶意输入篡改意图，或是追求与委托方相背离的利益。若想让这类智能体构成的协作经济生态真正运转起来，各参与方亟需一种坚实可靠的契约形式，即便无需费力审查对方智能体的内部实现或盲目托付信任，也能安心建立协作。 > AI agents increasingly act on behalf of people or other agents, purchasing services, exchanging information and delegating work. What an agent must respect is written in instructions, policies or agreements, but text alone cannot make it comply. It may make mistakes, be redirected by what it reads, or pursue different interests. For an economy of such agents to function, parties need agreements they can rely on without inspecting or trusting one another's agents. 我们在此提出**携带证明合约 (Proof-Carrying Contracts, PC2)**，这是一个能够让约定的约束条件在智能体与系统交互全过程中具备强制执行效力的架构。在任何被请求的操作得以运行之前，智能体必须主动递交一份机器可自动检验的数学证明，证明提议的操作在其行为模型所允许的每一种可能情况下，均能严格保留既定约束。名为**气闸 (Airlock)** 的执行系统将对该证明展开严格校验，并以此掌控对底层操作权限的开放与拦截。 > We introduce **Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2)**, a framework for making agreed constraints enforceable throughout an agent's interactions with a system. Before a requested operation can run, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof that it preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model. An execution system called the **Airlock** checks the proof and controls access to the operation. 在这一体系中，协作各方只需专注明确需要保留的安全条件，而智能体自身则负责提供证明其决策合法性所需的推理逻辑，同时享有自如调整策略的充分空间。这避免了为系统费力设计繁复的静态权限策略，并逐项证明其允许的每个决策都安全可靠的工程负担。我们在理论上证明，即便面对恶意对抗的智能体，这些约束在运行周期的每一个瞬间都能严格成立，并厘清了何时能将该数学安全性平移至现实世界的实际安全。此外，可复用的能力模块为合约的组装提供了现成的工具库与理论保障。PC2 框架为未来的智能体经济打下了可信基石，使达成的协议既能有效保护委派工作的发起方，也能切实保障具体承担任务的智能体本身。 > The parties specify the conditions to preserve, while the agent supplies the reasoning needed to justify its decisions and remains free to adapt its strategy. This avoids having to design a separate permission policy and prove that every decision it permits is safe. We prove that the constraints hold at every instant during execution, even for an adversarial agent, and identify when this implies safety in the world. Reusable capability modules provide tools and guarantees from which contracts can be constructed. PC2 provides a foundation for an agent economy whose agreements protect both those delegating work and those carrying it out. --- ## 🔗 全文与相关资源 > ## 🔗 Full-Text & Resources * **阅读 PDF 论文：** [arXiv:2610.28484 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28484) * **网页 HTML 版：** [arXiv HTML (Experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.28484v1) * **数字对象唯一标识符 (DOI)：** [10.48550/arXiv.2610.28484](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2610.28484) * **许可协议：** [知识共享署名 4.0 国际许可 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International)](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) > * **View PDF:** [arXiv:2610.28484 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28484) > * **HTML Version:** [arXiv HTML (Experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.28484v1) > * **DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.2610.28484](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2610.28484) > * **License:** [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) >

item.title: 局部允许，全局拒绝：为什么单动作授权在 LLM 智能体中无法组合
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/局部允许-全局拒绝-为什么单动作授权在-LLM-智能体中无法组合/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/局部允许-全局拒绝-为什么单动作授权在-LLM-智能体中无法组合/
item.description:
在让 AI 智能体 (AI Agent) 自主调用工具、收发邮件和查询数据库时，主流业界普遍采用“单动作授权 (Per-Action Authorization)”护栏——即每当智能体发起一次工具调用，安全守卫就孤立地审查这一步是否违规并决定放行与否。然而，本论文揭示了一个颠覆性的安全盲区：“局部安全放行，绝不等于全局安全”，这种孤立审查机制在组合场景下必然失效。研究团队在理论上严格证明，跨越多次执行的意图与合规违规属于“2-安全超属性 (2-Safety Hyperproperties)”，在单条执行轨迹中根本无法归咎于任何单独一步动作；同时，基于 SAT/SMT 形式化方法研发的 **AL-SYNTH** 综合器成功合成了能够完全避开 9 种顶尖大语言模型审查的最小攻击反例。这一突破性研究敲响了警钟：现有的单一工具拦截护栏在架构上存在根本性缺陷，智能体安全防御必须从“单步排查”全面跃升至“跨执行轨迹的全局动态关联比对”。
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
当今的自主大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 智能体在与现实世界交互时，绝大多数依赖所谓的“单动作授权 (Per-Action Authorization)”机制——这就像是在智能体的每个工具调用前派驻了一位本地保安，孤立地盘查当前这一步操作是否越界。然而，本研究深刻地指出：**局部的合规放行，根本无法自然组合成全局的安全保障**。
> Autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically rely on "per-action authorization"—a local security guard that screens each individual tool call in isolation. This paper demonstrates that **local authorization does not compose into global authorization**.
作者团队将这种现象形式化定义为**组合式授权失效 (Compositional Authorization Failure, CAF)**：智能体在单次或成对的执行轨迹中，每一步工具调用都能顺利通过局部安全审查，但整体行为却粗暴违反了涵盖真实意图、使用目的、数据溯源、用户知情同意与权限委托的全局安全策略。论文引入了一款名为 **AL-SYNTH** 的 SAT/SMT 形式化综合器 (Synthesizer)，并在数学上证明了关系型目的违规本质上属于“2-安全超属性 (2-Safety Hyperproperties)”，在孤立的单条轨迹中根本找不到任何一个能单独“背锅”的责任点。其致命结论是：如果监视器不追踪跨执行的关联信息，那么它要么对这类越权违规彻底失明，要么就只能以大量“捕风捉影”的误报为代价。
> The authors define a **Compositional Authorization Failure (CAF)** as an execution (or pair of executions) that passes local checks while violating a broader global policy (covering intent, purpose, provenance, consent, and delegation). Through the introduction of **AL-SYNTH**—a SAT/SMT synthesizer—the study proves that relational purpose violations form 2-safety hyperproperties that lack any per-trace locus of blame. Consequently, single-action monitors cannot detect them without cross-execution tracking or accepting false alarms.
---
## 元数据与参考信息
> ## Metadata & Reference Information
* **arXiv 编号：** [arXiv:2610.27620](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27620) [cs.CR] * **论文作者：** Anmol Pandey, Aditya Jain, Liang Chen, Carsten Maple * **提交时间：** 2026 年 10 月 20 日 * **主要学科领域：** 密码学与安全 (`cs.CR`) * **交叉学科领域：** 人工智能 (`cs.AI`)、计算机科学中的逻辑学 (`cs.LO`) * **ACM 分类号：** D.4.6; F.3.1; I.2.11 * **会议收录背景：** 本文为第 8 届 IEEE 智能系统与应用中的信任、隐私与安全国际会议 (IEEE TPS 2026) 录用论文的扩展版本。 * **相关资源：** [GitHub 仓库 (AL-SYNTH)](https://github.com/anmolpandey299/al-synth) | [论文 PDF 原文](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.27620)
> * **arXiv Identifier:** [arXiv:2610.27620](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27620) [cs.CR] > * **Authors:** Anmol Pandey, Aditya Jain, Liang Chen, Carsten Maple > * **Submitted:** 20 October 2026 > * **Primary Subject:** Cryptography and Security (`cs.CR`) > * **Secondary Subjects:** Artificial Intelligence (`cs.AI`), Logic in Computer Science (`cs.LO`) > * **ACM Classifications:** D.4.6; F.3.1; I.2.11 > * **Conference Context:** Extended version of a paper accepted at the 8th IEEE International Conference on Trust, Privacy and Security in Intelligent Systems and Applications (IEEE TPS 2026). > * **Resources:** [GitHub Repository (AL-SYNTH)](https://github.com/anmolpandey299/al-synth) | [View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.27620)
---
## 论文摘要
> ## Abstract
自主大语言模型智能体通常在单动作授权的保护下通过工具行使权力：局部安全守卫会逐一且孤立地审查每一次工具调用。我们在本文中证明，局部授权无法自动组合为全局授权。所谓组合式授权失效 (Compositional Authorization Failure, CAF)，是指这样一种执行轨迹（或成对的执行轨迹）：其中的每一次工具调用都能被局部防护判定为合法，但整体执行组合起来后，却违背了涵盖意图、目的、数据溯源、知情同意以及权限委托的全局策略。
> Autonomous LLM agents act through tools under per-action authorization: a local guard screens each tool call in isolation. We show that local authorization does not compose into global authorization. A compositional authorization failure (CAF) is a locally authorized execution, or a pair of locally authorized executions, that violates a global policy spanning intent, purpose, provenance, consent, and delegation.
我们从两个维度对 CAF 进行了系统刻画：其一是表达能力（单轨迹安全性对比关系型 k-安全性），其二是可观测性（从低到高的监视器能力层级阶梯）。我们的核心研究结论是一个形式化的不可行定理：关系型目的违规在数学形式上构成一种“2-安全超属性”，在单条执行轨迹内部没有任何一个动作可以被单独定罪为违规原因。因此，任何力求做到“零误报”的单动作监视器，无论底层换用多么强大的模型或决策判定算法，都必定对这类违规彻底失灵；唯有引入跨执行轨迹的比对监视，这类漏洞才可能被捕获——然而，在我们调研的现存六大主流安全护栏框架中，竟无一具备这种跨执行追踪能力。
> We characterize CAFs along two axes, expressiveness (single-trace safety versus relational k-safety) and observability (a ladder of monitor profiles). Our central result is an impossibility: relational purpose violations form a 2-safety hyperproperty with no per-trace locus of blame, so a per-action monitor that never raises a false alarm detects none of them, independent of the underlying model or decision procedure; they become visible only under cross-execution monitoring, which none of the six guardrails we survey implements.
为了将这一理论缺陷具象化，我们构建了 **AL-SYNTH**——一款完全不依赖语言模型、基于可满足性求解 (SAT/SMT) 的形式化综合器，它能够精准自动化生成触发 CAF 的最小反例见证 (Witness)，并通过穷举基准预言机完成严格校验。实验暴露出的表征极具讽刺意味：在 9 种主流大语言模型担任安全评判者的测试中，只要采用单动作视角，这些模型几乎无一例外地批准了被合成的反例动作，其拦截率低得与完全无害的良性对照组毫无二致；然而，一旦把两段执行轨迹合并展示给同一个模型时，它却能立刻准确识别并发出警报。由此可见，对于无法降维规约为单轨迹安全性的关系型安全策略而言，单动作授权在架构上存在不可弥补的先天的结构性缺陷：若要防范此类威胁，监视系统要么必须具备跨执行轨迹的比对分析能力，要么就只能全盘忍受误杀良性操作的高误报率。
> We make this constructive with **AL-SYNTH**, a SAT/SMT synthesizer (using no language model) that emits minimal CAF witnesses, each checked against an exhaustive oracle. The empirical signature is sharp: across nine LLM judges the per-action view approves the synthesized witness almost without exception, blocking it at a rate comparable to a benign control, yet the same models flag it when shown the two executions together. Per-action authorization is therefore structurally insufficient for relational policy conjuncts not reducible to single-trace safety: to bound them, a monitor must compare executions or accept false alarms.

item.title: 专精化小语言模型词表：实际应用中如何削减 77% 推理成本
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/专精化小语言模型词表-实际应用中如何削减-77-推理成本/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/专精化小语言模型词表-实际应用中如何削减-77-推理成本/
item.description:
通用开源大模型通常配备覆盖全领域与多语言的庞大分词器 (Tokenizer)，但在具体的垂直业务落地中，这种“大而全”的通用词表不仅会导致领域高频短语被切碎成过多微小 Token，更会在解码阶段浪费宝贵的显存带宽去为数十万个毫不相干的词条计算概率。来自 Dharma-AI 的团队推出了创新的小语言模型 (Small Language Model, SLM) 词表定制技术 VocabX，打破了以往单纯依据词频统计的传统思路，首次以底层硬件的“实际 Token 生成成本”为导向重构与裁剪词表。在完全不改动基础模型权重与训练配方的前提下，VocabX 不仅使葡萄牙语作文批改模型的输出 Token 数量压缩超 70%，更将端到端实测推理成本骤降 77%，同时基准测试准确率逆势提升了 15%。这项技术突破向业界证明：领域专精化不必拘泥于模型参数与微调数据，在分词器阶段对词表进行精准“量体裁衣”，同样能以极低代价释放惊人的能效红利。
---
## 执行摘要
> ## Executive Summary
通用开源模型（如 Qwen 和 Gemma）通常依赖面向全领域和跨语言文本构建的分词器。但当它们被微调用于单一垂直任务（例如自动化作文阅卷）时，这种通用词表就会暴露出巨大的能效短板：特定领域的常用词组被生硬地切碎为过多微小的 Token，模型更被迫浪费宝贵的显存带宽，在每一次生成时为数十万个毫不相干的无效 Token 计算概率分布。
> General open-source models (such as Qwen and Gemma) rely on tokenizers built for universal domains and cross-lingual text. When fine-tuned for a single task—such as an automated essay grader—this general vocabulary leads to massive inefficiencies: domain-specific phrases are fragmented into excessive tokens, and the model wastes memory calculating probabilities for hundreds of thousands of irrelevant tokens.
本文介绍了 **VocabX**，这是一种用于专精化小语言模型词表的新方法。与以往单纯依据原始词频统计的做法不同，它开创性地以**实际 Token 生成成本**作为核心优化指标。在完全不改动基础模型权重的前提下，VocabX 围绕子词 (Sub-word) 合并与宏 Token (Macro Token) 重新重塑了词表结构，在实际测试中**成功将实测推理成本降低高达 77%**，同时在基准测试 (Benchmark) 中的综合表现反而实现了提升。
> This article previews **VocabX**, a novel method for specializing a Small Language Model's (SLM) vocabulary based on *token generation cost* rather than mere raw frequency. By reshaping the vocabulary around sub-word merging and macro tokens without modifying the base model's weights, VocabX **cuts measured inference costs by up to 77%** while simultaneously *increasing* benchmark performance.
---
## 引言
> ## Introduction
``` [Base Tokenizer] -> 14 tokens for a standard phrase [VocabX Tokenizer]-> 4 tokens for the same phrase ```
[![Same sentence, fewer tokens: 14 tokens with the base tokenizer, 4 with VocabX](./images/09e935c19314.png)](./images/09e935c19314.png)
通常情况下，人们普遍将分词器视为预训练基础模型不可分割的固有属性。然而在面向特定领域的专用模型中，分词器却是一个至关重要的成本杠杆——而且这个杠杆在模型正式开始训练之前就已经完全定型了。
> Typically, tokenizers are viewed as fixed properties of a pre-trained base model. However, for a domain-specific model, the tokenizer is one of the largest cost levers, set entirely before training begins.
以基于 Qwen3-4B 构建的葡萄牙语自动化作文批改系统为例。尽管该模型体积小巧且经过了针对性微调，但它依然沿用了原生包含 151,669 个词条的分词器——而这个庞大的词表最初是为通用的多语言应用场景设计的。这种“水土不服”带来了两大结构性瓶颈：
> Consider an automated Portuguese essay grader built on Qwen3-4B. While the model is compact and fine-tuned, it retained its original 151,669-entry tokenizer meant for general multi-lingual applications. This introduced two structural bottlenecks:
1. **领域常用文本消耗了过多的 Token**； 2. **每次生成一个 Token 时，模型都必须在庞大的词表中进行概率计算**，即便其中绝大部分词条在阅卷任务中永远不会被用到。
> 1. Frequent domain text required excessive tokens. > 2. The model evaluated a massive vocabulary for every single generated token, even though many entries were never used.
在保持训练数据、基础模型和微调策略完全一致的前提下，我们仅仅通过 VocabX 重建了词表，就让整个模型架构获得了立竿见影的能效飞跃。
> By rebuilding the vocabulary using VocabX while keeping the data, base model, and training recipe identical, we achieved dramatic architectural efficiencies.
---
## 为通用大众设计的词表：专精领域的隐形负担
> ## A Vocabulary Built for Everyone
通用基础模型的分词器通常是在覆盖代码、法律合同以及数十种语言的海量互联网文本上训练而成的。对于无所不包的通用聊天机器人而言，这种设计自然无可挑剔；但当模型被落地部署在特定垂直领域时，这种“面面俱到”的做法就会引发两类严重的算力浪费：
> General-purpose model tokenizers are trained on massive, broad web text collections spanning code, contracts, and multiple languages. While ideal for universal chatbots, this approach causes two major types of waste when deployed in specialized domains:
* **碎片化 (Fragmentation)**：分词器会将领域内高频重复的固定句式生硬地拆解成大量微小的子词。例如在我们批改作文的场景中，固定的 JSON 包装外壳、能力维度名称以及评价术语，都被无端切碎成了若干个零散的 Token。 * **冗余冗繁 (Excess)**：词表中保留了成千万个永远用不到的多余条目。例如一个批改生物考试的模型，在每生成一步时居然都要为生僻的汉字计算一次概率分布，白白耗费了巨大的显存带宽。
> * **Fragmentation:** The tokenizer breaks down repetitive domain phrasing into tiny sub-words. In our essay grader, boilerplate JSON envelopes, competency names, and evaluation phrases were shattered into multiple tokens. > * **Excess:** The vocabulary retains tens of thousands of unused entries. A biology exam grader computes probabilities for Chinese characters at every step, wasting memory bandwidth.
[![The span the grader writes in every response takes 12 tokens with the base tokenizer and 1 with VocabX](./images/bf09d7c55b11.png)](./images/bf09d7c55b11.png)
*左图：基础分词器需要占用 12 个 Token。右图：VocabX 仅需 1 个 Token。*
> *Left: 12 tokens with base tokenizer. Right: 1 token with VocabX.*
[![151,669 vocabulary entries in the base tokenizer, 64,767 with VocabX](./images/4e119eca29d9.png)](./images/4e119eca29d9.png)
*大幅缩减词表体积，可显著降低模型在解码过程中的显存开销。*
> *Reducing vocabulary size lowers memory overhead during decoding.*
---
## 读便宜，写昂贵：拆解大模型的生成成本
> ## Reading Is Cheap, Writing Is Expensive
想要理解为什么生成不同 Token 的成本会有天壤之别，我们必须深入剖析大语言模型推理 (Inference) 的两个阶段：
> To understand why token generation costs scale disproportionately, examine inference phases:
* **预填充阶段 (Prefill)**：一次性并行处理所有输入的 Prompt Token，属于典型的算力受限 (Compute-bound) 阶段。 * **解码阶段 (Decode)**：逐字串行生成回复，属于典型的显存带宽受限 (Memory-bandwidth bound) 阶段。
> * **Prefill:** Processes input tokens in a single pass; compute-bound. > * **Decode:** Generates responses sequentially; memory-bandwidth bound.
[![In the case we measured, writing a token cost 7.4 times reading one](./images/66c0eef7445b.png)](./images/66c0eef7445b.png)
在我们的作文批改模型实测中，**“写”一个 Token（解码输出）的硬件开销，竟是“读”一个 Token（预填充输入）的 7.4 倍之多**！此外，负责将隐藏状态映射到词表概率得分的语言模型头 (Language Modeling Head, LM Head) 层，占据了一个 4B 模型约 10% 的总参数量。词表矩阵中每多出一行，都会在解码的每一步带来额外的显存数据搬运开销。而 VocabX 将该批改模型的输出层从约 152,000 行大刀阔斧地精简到了约 65,000 行。
> In our essay grader configuration, **writing a single token cost 7.4 times more than reading one**. Furthermore, the Language Modeling (LM) head layer (which maps hidden states to vocabulary scores) accounts for roughly 10% of a 4B model's parameters. Every extra row in the vocabulary matrix adds memory movement overhead at every decode step. VocabX shrinks the grader's output layer from ~152,000 rows to ~65,000 rows.
---
## 为何现有解决方案功亏一篑
> ## Why Existing Solutions Fell Short
此前业界探索的基准方法——如快速词表迁移 (Fast Vocabulary Transfer, FVT)、多词分词 (Multi-Word Tokenization, MWT) 以及 Liquid AI 提出的就地分词器扩展方案，主要存在两大硬伤：
> Prior reference methods like Fast Vocabulary Transfer (FVT), Multi-Word Tokenization (MWT), and Liquid AI's in-place tokenizer expansion exhibit two main weaknesses:
1. **基于词频而非成本进行筛选 (Frequency-based rather than cost-based selection)**：这些方法仅仅根据 Token 出现的绝对频率进行优化，却完全忽视了该 Token 究竟是处于低成本的“输入阶段”，还是高成本的“生成阶段”。 2. **单层优化的局限性 (Single-layer limitation)**：它们要么仅专注于子词的切分调整，要么仅针对短语层面的合并，极少能在统一的优化框架下兼顾两者。
> 1. **Frequency-based rather than cost-based selection:** They optimize for how often a token appears, ignoring whether it is part of a high-cost generation phase. > 2. **Single-layer limitation:** They handle either sub-word segmentation or phrase merging, but rarely both under a unified optimization scheme.
---
## 破局之道：VocabX 的技术实现

item.title: TorchNeuron 性能分析 (一)：AWS Trainium 系统级性能剖析
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/TorchNeuron-性能分析-一-AWS-Trainium-系统级性能剖析/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/TorchNeuron-性能分析-一-AWS-Trainium-系统级性能剖析/
item.description:
在机器学习与大模型工业化落地的过程中，仅仅让模型成功跑通代码只是打下了地基，要想真正压榨硬件算力、降低推理与训练成本，就必须建立系统化的性能分析 (Profiling) 能力以探查瓶颈根因。本文作为系列实战教程的第一篇，深入讲解了如何在 AWS 自研 AI 加速芯片 Trainium 上，借助其开源原生 PyTorch 后端 TorchNeuron 开展系统级性能剖析。文章完整演示了如何通过标准 `torch.profiler` 捕获设备级耗时、利用 `key_averages()` 表格定位热点算子，并在可视化分析套件 Neuron Explorer 中层层穿透从上层框架调度、运行时管理到物理硬件执行的完整流转轨迹。最后，文章以 RMSNorm 算子为例进行基准测试，揭示了从普通即时执行到内置融合算子与 `torch.compile` 图优化带来的约 6 倍性能飞跃，为云端定制芯片上的深度性能调优提供了坚实可依的实践指南。
---
## 执行摘要
> ## Executive Summary
想方设法让机器学习模型跑得飞快往往只是优化工作的一半；更关键的是在模型变慢时，能够清晰洞察其背后的根因，而这离不开系统化的性能剖析。在本文作为该系列的第一部分中，我们将探索如何借助 **TorchNeuron**（**AWS Trainium** 芯片的原生开源 PyTorch 后端）来深入分析模型推理性能。本指南将带你完整实践：如何正确配置 `torch.profiler`、如何通过 `key_averages()` 表格快速揪出执行瓶颈、如何在 **Neuron Explorer** 中直观审查执行轨迹 (Traces)，并横向对比未经优化的朴素即时模式 (Eager) 算子、原生内置融合算子 (`torch.rms_norm`) 与基于计算图编译 (`torch.compile`) 三者之间的显著性能差异。
> Understanding how to make machine learning models run fast is only half the battle; knowing *why* a model is slow requires systematic profiling. In Part 1 of this series, we explore how to analyze inference performance on **AWS Trainium** using **TorchNeuron** (its native open-source PyTorch backend). This guide walks you through configuring `torch.profiler`, analyzing execution bottlenecks via `key_averages()`, visualizing traces in **Neuron Explorer**, and comparing the performance differences between naive eager operations, built-in fused operators (`torch.rms_norm`), and compiled graphs (`torch.compile`).
---
## Neuron 作为 PyTorch 后端
> ## Neuron as a PyTorch Backend
在正式开始对工作负载进行性能分析之前，先理清 [Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/index.html) 与 PyTorch 之间的整合机制大有裨益。
> Before profiling workloads, it helps to understand how [Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/index.html) integrates with PyTorch.
Neuron 后端充分借助了 PyTorch 官方提供的 `PrivateUse1` 扩展机制。该机制允许第三方硬件加速芯片原生无缝地融入 PyTorch 生态，而无需在上游框架内核中硬编码专有的分发调度键 (Dispatch Key，如传统针对 GPU 的 `cuda`)。`torch_neuronx` 扩展包与上游 PyTorch 紧密配合，将 Neuron 正式注册为一个原生的执行目标设备。欲深入了解这一扩展机制的实现细节，可参阅 PyTorch 官方教程：[借助 PrivateUse1 简化新后端集成 (Facilitating New Backend Integration by PrivateUse1)](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/advanced/privateuseone.html)。
> The Neuron backend leverages PyTorch's `PrivateUse1` extension point. This mechanism allows accelerators to integrate natively into the framework without requiring a dedicated dispatch key (such as `cuda`). The `torch_neuronx` package works alongside upstream PyTorch to register Neuron as a native execution target. For more information on this extension mechanism, refer to the official PyTorch guide on [Facilitating New Backend Integration by PrivateUse1](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/advanced/privateuseone.html).
---
## 配置性能分析器
> ## Set Up the Profiler
对 Neuron 计算任务进行性能采样与分析主要依赖两个核心模块：
> Profiling a Neuron workload relies on two primary components:
1. **`NeuronConfig`**：负责精细控制所需采集的数据流与具体的 NeuronCore 核心，并指定分析结果的输出存储路径。该配置对象通过 `experimental_config` 参数传递给 `torch.profiler.profile`。 2. **`NeuronProfiler`**：接收并解析 `NeuronConfig` 配置，对外暴露 `export_trace` 回调函数，以便在导出上层深度学习框架跟踪数据 (`trace.json`) 的同时，同步写出底层的系统硬件级跟踪轨迹。
> 1. **`NeuronConfig`**: Controls which data streams and NeuronCores to capture, specifying the output destination. Passed to `torch.profiler.profile` via `experimental_config`. > 2. **`NeuronProfiler`**: Consumes the `NeuronConfig` and exposes an `export_trace` callback to write out the framework trace (`trace.json`) alongside low-level system traces.
```python nc = NeuronConfig( modes=[ProfileMode.DEVICE, ProfileMode.RUNTIME], profile_output_dir=OUTPUT_DIR, capture_enabled_for_nc='0', correlate_device_time=True, ) exporter = NeuronProfiler(nc) ```
将 `correlate_device_time=True` 启用后，分析器会自动把设备端的实际底层执行耗时直接关联映射到 `key_averages()` 统计表中，从而让开发者能够一目了然地横向对比 CPU 端调度与 Neuron 硬件设备端计算的各自开销。关于所有可配置参数的详细说明，可查阅 [NeuronConfig 分析模式文档 (NeuronConfig Profile Modes documentation)](http://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/how-to-profile-workload.html#neuronconfig-profile-modes)。
> Setting `correlate_device_time=True` correlates the device-level time directly into the `key_averages()` table, enabling side-by-side comparison of CPU and Neuron device execution costs. For comprehensive parameter details, consult the [NeuronConfig Profile Modes documentation](http://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/how-to-profile-workload.html#neuronconfig-profile-modes).
---
## 可视化分析利器：Neuron Explorer
> ## Tooling: Neuron Explorer
**Neuron Explorer** 是一款可通过浏览器进行交互的可视化效能诊断工具，专为审查系统级执行轨迹、硬件设备时间线以及底层执行引擎瓶颈而设计。开发者不仅可以通过 SSH 端口转发直接在本地浏览器中打开它，也可以通过专属的 VS Code 扩展进行集成查看。
> **Neuron Explorer** is a browser-accessible utility designed to inspect system traces, device timelines, and engine-level bottlenecks. It can be accessed via an SSH tunnel or a VS Code extension.
在完成性能分析之后，输出目录中会生成系统级跟踪数据，以及通过统一哈希特征关联配对的 `.neff` (Neuron 可执行文件格式，Neuron Executable File Format) 和 `.ntff` (硬件底层指令跟踪文件，Hardware Instruction Trace) 文件。有关如何在 Web 界面中启动工具及上传分析文件的图文步骤，请参阅 [步骤 5：在 Neuron Explorer 中上传您的分析文件 (Step 5: Upload your profile in Neuron Explorer)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/get-started.html#step-5-upload-your-profile)。
> After profiling, the output directory includes system traces and matching `.neff` (Neuron Executable File Format) and `.ntff` (hardware instruction trace) files linked by a shared hash. For detailed instructions on launching and uploading files to the UI, see [Step 5: Upload your profile in Neuron Explorer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/get-started.html#step-5-upload-your-profile).
---
## 实战分析案例：RMSNorm 算子
> ## Profile RMSNorm
为了生动形象地演示系统级性能分析流程，我们选取了 **RMSNorm** 作为切入点——这是一个计算结构极为轻量且规整的算子，包含了一段规律非常明确的规约计算与逐元素 (Element-wise) 算术运算。我们在基准测试中对比了三种截然不同的实现方式：
> To demonstrate system-level profiling, we examine **RMSNorm**—a lightweight operation containing a predictable sequence of reductions and element-wise arithmetic. We test three distinct implementations:
1. **朴素 RMSNorm 实现 (Naive RMSNorm)**：完全由离散的 PyTorch 基础算子手动拼装实现 (包括乘法、求均值、加法和平方根倒数)。 2. **`torch.rms_norm()`**：PyTorch 原生提供的内置标准函数，在 Neuron 硬件平台下会自动下沉为单个高度融合、高度优化的设备端内核 (Kernel)。 3. **结合 `torch.compile` 的朴素 RMSNorm**：依然采用由离散算子拼装的代码逻辑，但通过声明 `@torch.compile(backend="neuron")` 由编译器自动进行计算图追踪与内核融合优化。
> 1. **Naive RMSNorm**: Written with discrete PyTorch operations (multiplication, mean, addition, reciprocal square root). > 2. **`torch.rms_norm()`**: PyTorch’s built-in function lowered to a single optimized, fused kernel on Neuron. > 3. **Naive RMSNorm with `torch.compile`**: The discrete sequence compiled automatically using `@torch.compile(backend="neuron")`.
所有评测脚本均使用完全一致的输入张量维度形状与分析器配置。可供复现的完整代码均已归档于 [torch-neuronx 官方示例仓库 (torch-neuronx examples directory)](https://github.com/aws-neuron/torch-neuronx/tree/main/examples/hf_profiling_blog_pt1)。
> All scripts use identical shapes and profiler configurations. Reproducible code can be found in the [torch-neuronx examples directory](https://github.com/aws-neuron/torch-neuronx/tree/main/examples/hf_profiling_blog_pt1).
---
## 分析场景 1：朴素 PyTorch 基础算子拼装
> ## Profile 1: Naive PyTorch Operations
使用基础的 PyTorch 离散算子拼装 RMSNorm 计算逻辑，会在运行时产生大量不必要的中间张量，并反复触发昂贵的框架级调度与分发事件：
> Writing RMSNorm out using primitive PyTorch operations creates intermediate tensors and multiple dispatch events:
```python device = torch.device('neuron')
x = torch.randn(4, 512, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device) weight = torch.ones(512, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
def rms_norm_fn(t): x_sq = t * t # square mean_sq = x_sq.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) # mean of squares rms = torch.rsqrt(mean_sq + 1e-6) # 1 / sqrt(mean_sq + eps) return t * rms * weight # normalize + scale ```
我们通过配置 `ProfilerActivity.PrivateUse1` 这一活动类型，并将预先初始化的 `NeuronConfig` 实例传入分析器：
> We configure the profiler using `ProfilerActivity.PrivateUse1` and pass `NeuronConfig`:
```python with torch.profiler.profile( activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.PrivateUse1], experimental_config=nc, record_shapes=False, on_trace_ready=exporter.export_trace, schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=2, warmup=1, active=1), ) as prof: for step in range(4): with torch.no_grad(): _ = rms_norm_fn(x) torch.neuron.synchronize() prof.step() ```
*(注：在循环中显式加入 `torch.neuron.synchronize()` 能够确保硬件设备在导出轨迹数据之前彻底完成所有运算排队，从而避免分析报表中出现设备耗时列全为空白的情况。)*
> *(Note: Including `torch.neuron.synchronize()` ensures the device completes operations before trace export, avoiding empty device time columns.)*
将分析生成的汇总表按照设备端执行总耗时进行降序排序，主要的性能瓶颈便立刻浮出水面：
> Sorting the summary table by device time highlights the performance bottlenecks:
```python print(prof.key_averages().table(sort_by="self_privateuse1_time_total", row_limit=4)) ```
[![核心平均值汇总表显示，三次 aten::mul 调用占据了 Neuron 设备端耗时的最大份额。](./images/af39c8c42d9a.png)](./images/af39c8c42d9a.png)
*核心平均值汇总表显示，三次 aten::mul 调用占据了 Neuron 设备端耗时的最大份额。*
> *The key averages table shows that three aten::mul calls account for the largest share of Neuron device time.*
| 算子名称 (Name) | 调用次数 (# Calls) | 自身 CPU 耗时 (Self CPU) | 自身 NEURON 耗时 (Self NEURON) | NEURON 耗时占比 (% NEURON) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `aten::mul` | 3 | 60.9 μs | 1,164.5 μs | 49.5% | | `aten::add` | 1 | 26.6 μs | 434.6 μs | 18.5% | | `aten::rsqrt` | 1 | 15.6 μs | 415.0 μs | 17.6% | | `aten::mean` | 1 | 21.1 μs | 340.8 μs | 14.5% |
> | Name | # Calls | Self CPU | Self NEURON | % NEURON | > | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | > | `aten::mul` | 3 | 60.9 μs | 1,164.5 μs | 49.5% | > | `aten::add` | 1 | 26.6 μs | 434.6 μs | 18.5% | > | `aten::rsqrt` | 1 | 15.6 μs | 415.0 μs | 17.6% | > | `aten::mean` | 1 | 21.1 μs | 340.8 μs | 14.5% |
*自身 NEURON 设备端总执行耗时：2.355 ms*
> *Self NEURON total: 2.355 ms*
[![Neuron Explorer 完整追踪了 aten::mul 操作从框架分发、运行时调度到在 Neuron 物理硬件泳道上执行的全链路流程。](./images/09da1436bc0c.png)](./images/09da1436bc0c.png)
*Neuron Explorer 完整追踪了 aten::mul 操作从框架分发、运行时调度到在 Neuron 物理硬件泳道上执行的全链路流程。*
> *Neuron Explorer follows an aten::mul operation from framework dispatch through runtime scheduling to execution on the Neuron hardware lanes.*

item.title: Racer：利用符号等价性检查捕获 GPU 算子内核漏洞
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/Racer-利用符号等价性检查捕获-GPU-算子内核漏洞/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-22/Racer-利用符号等价性检查捕获-GPU-算子内核漏洞/
item.description:
在现代人工智能计算体系中，GPU 算子内核 (GPU Kernel) 是支撑深度学习超高算力的基石，然而面对硬件架构演进、新型低精度数据格式普及与多种编程语言重写，确保算子功能的绝对正确性极为艰难。传统上工业界主要依赖随机张量的差分测试，但这往往存在严重的致命盲区——那些引发微小数值偏差的代码逻辑漏洞很容易被误当成正常的浮点舍入误差而漏检。为攻克这一行业顽疾，研究团队推出了名为 **Racer** 的创新验证引擎，开创性地在 PTX (Parallel Thread Execution) 指令级引入**符号等价性检查 (Symbolic Equivalence Checking)**，通过符号推演将输出转化为精确代数表达式，并借助形状缩减、锁步 CTA 调度与惯用模版反驳三大技术攻克状态爆炸难题。在对 41 个生产级算子集合中 2,408 个内核的全面排查中，Racer 成功揪出了 23 个知名开源库中的 **82 个真实漏洞**（含 76 个此前未知的隐蔽缺陷），为大模型时代高可靠底层算子的开发构筑了坚实的形式化护城河。
---
## 📋 内容概要
> ## Summary
GPU 算子内核是现代人工智能实现极致计算性能的心脏。然而，随着底层硬件架构快速迭代、新型数值格式（如 FP8、INT4）层出不穷以及新兴编程语言（如 Triton、CUDA）的演进，开发者需要频繁重写这些底层算子。长期以来，工业界为了确保新重写的算子在功能上与原版完全一致，主要依赖**差分测试 (Differential Testing)**——即生成一批随机张量，让新算子和经过验证的基准参考算子同时运行，并在允许的数值误差容限 (Tolerance) 内比对两者的输出结果。然而，这种测试方法存在致命的盲区：由于浮点运算天然存在舍入误差，差分测试不得不放宽比对阈值；一旦内核中潜藏的代码逻辑漏洞所引发的输出偏差恰好落在这个容限范围内，就会悄无声息地逃过检测，给后续的大模型训练和推理埋下难以排查的“暗雷”。
> GPU kernels are fundamental to modern AI performance, but operators are constantly rewritten across hardware generations, numeric formats, and languages. Traditionally, ensuring these rewrites preserve functional correctness relies on *differential testing*—running a new kernel against a trusted reference on random tensors and comparing outputs within a tolerance. However, differential testing has severe blind spots, such as logical bugs that produce errors smaller than the required tolerance.
为了从根源上化解这一难题，研究团队提出了**符号等价性检查**的新范式。该方法不再喂入具体的随机数值，而是将张量作为抽象的代数符号输入并执行内核，最终将算子的输出转化为覆盖整个输入空间的精确代数表达式。这样一来，系统便能在数学层面上彻底隔绝并清晰区分浮点舍入误差与真正的代码逻辑缺陷。基于这一思路，本研究推出了名为 **Racer** 的验证引擎，它直接工作在 NVIDIA GPU 的 PTX 汇编中间指令级别，并由以下三项核心技术创新驱动：
> To solve this, the authors propose **symbolic equivalence checking**. By executing kernels on symbolic inputs, outputs are turned into exact algebraic expressions that cover the entire input space and cleanly distinguish floating-point errors from logical bugs. The paper introduces **Racer**, a PTX-level symbolic equivalence checking engine powered by three key innovations:
1. **形状缩减 (Shape Reduction)**：大幅压缩张量维度与执行规模，从而精准控制符号推演的计算复杂度； 2. **锁步 CTA 调度器 (Lockstep CTA Scheduler)**：高效模拟和管控 GPU 协同线程阵列 (Cooperative Thread Array, CTA) 的硬件级并发行为； 3. **惯用模版反驳机制 (Idiom Templates with Exact Numeric Refutation)**：针对符号推演难以直接给出定论的边界情况，结合精确数值反例进行强力反驳与判定。
> 1. **Shape Reduction** to control computational cost. > 2. **Lockstep CTA Scheduler** to manage hardware concurrency. > 3. **Idiom Templates** with exact numeric refutation for handling otherwise inconclusive results.
在涵盖 41 个常用代码集合、共计 2,408 个生产级 GPU 内核的严苛实测中，Racer 成功在 23 个知名开源算子库中挖掘出 **82 个真实存在的代码漏洞**（其中包括 76 个此前从未被发现的未知 Bug，且已有 41 个获得了库维护者的官方确认）。
> Tested across 2,408 production kernels from 41 collections, Racer uncovered **82 real bugs** across 23 libraries (including 76 previously unknown bugs and 41 confirmed).
---
